tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal ba 'jam dbyangs sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta chen po kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhabs kyi gsung rab dpe bsdur ma pod gnyis pa bzhugs/ /

༄༅/ /sdom pa gsum gyi rab tu dbye ba'i bstan bcos bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /sdom pa gsum gyi rab tu dbye ba zhes bya ba/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /bde gshegs bstan pa'i gsung rab seng ge'i sgra | | lta ngan ri dwags mtha' dag skrag par mdzad/ /sangs rgyas dgongs pa ji bzhin legs sgrub pa/ /mtshungs med bla ma de la bdag cag dad/ /skyon med yon tan kun gyi mdzod mnga' ba/ /'gro ba'i bla ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal nas/ /dad ldan sangs rgyas gsung bzhin bsgrub 'dod pa/ /de la sdaum gsum dbye ba bdag gis bshad/ /mkhas rnams dga' ba'i sdeb sbyor ni/ /blun po rnams kyis go dka' bas/ /tshig gi sbyor ba spangs nas kyang*/ /kun gyis go bar bya phyir bshad | | bdag ni sangs rgyas bstan pa la/ /mi phyed pa yi dad pa yod/ /'on kyang sangs rgyas bstan pa la/ /'khrul par spyod la bdag ma dad/ /so sor thar pa'i sdom pa dang*/ /byang chub sems dpa'i sems bskyed dang*/ /gsang sngags kyi ni dbang bskur dang*/ /de dag gi ni cho ga dang*/ /so so'i bslab par bya ba dang*/ / sems bskyed pa yi gnad rnams dang*/ /stong nyid snying rje'i snying po dang*/ /rim pa gnyis kyi gsang tshig dang*/ /ye shes phyag rgya chen po dang*/ /phyi dang nang gi rten 'brel dang*/ /sa dang lam gyi rnam gzhag gi /rnam par dbye ba bshad kyis nyon/ /so sor thar pa'i sdom pa la/ /nyan thos theg chen lugs gnyis yod/ /nyan thos rnams kyi skyabs 'gro nas/ /dge slong gi ni sdom pa'i bar/ /ji srid 'tsho yi bar du yin | | shi ba'i tshe na sdom pa gtong*/ /sdom pa rnams kyi 'bras bu ni/ /tshe 'phos nas ni 'byung bar 'gyur/ /byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa rnams/ /shi 'phos nas kyang rjes su 'brang*/ /de dag gi ni rgyu mtshan yang*/ /nyan thos sdom pa rnam rig min// lus ngag las ni skye bar 'dod/ /sdom pa gzugs can yin pa'i phyir/ /shi ba'i tshe na sdom pa gtong*/

/'di ni chos mngon mdzod las kyang*/ /bslab pa phul dang shi 'phos dang*/ /mtshan gnyis dag ni byung ba dang*/ /rtsa ba chad dang mtshan 'das las | | so sor thar pa'i 'dul ba gtong*/ /zhes gsungs 'di la tshad ma yin/ /byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa ni/ /sems las skye phyir gzugs can min/ /des na ji srid sems ma nyams/ /de yi bar du sdom pa yod/ /mdo rgyud bstan bcos thams cad kyi/ /dgongs pa yang ni de nyid yin/ kha cig ji srid 'tsho ba'i sgra/ / lus dang sems la dgongs zhes zer/ /de 'dra sangs rgyas dgongs pa min/ / mkhas pa'i gzhung las de ma bshad/ /de lta yin na nyan thos dang*/ /theg chen sdom pa khyad med 'gyur/ /thun mong thun mong ma yin pa'i/ /skyabs 'gro gnyis su dbye mi rung*/ /sdom pa 'bogs pa'i cho ga dang*/ /de yi bslab bya'ang gcig tu 'gyur/ /shi yang dge slong mi 'dor na/ /bslab pa phul ba la sogs pa/ /sdom pa gtong rgyu gzhan gyis kyang*/ /sdom pa gtong ba mi srid 'gyur/ /de la kha cig 'di skad du/ / sems bskyed kyis ni ma zin pa'i/ /sdom pa gal te gtong na yang*/ /byang chub sems kyis zin pa yi/ /sdom pa gtong ba mi srid lo/ /'o na sems bskyed kyis zin pa' | | dge slong la sogs sdom pa rnams/ /bslab pa phul dang shi 'phos dang*/ /rtsa ba chad pa la sogs pa/ /gtong rgyu kun gyis mi gtong 'gyur/ /de lta yin na dge slong gi /sdom pa phul yang bsrung dgos 'gyur/ /ma bsrungs dge slong nyams par 'gyur | | shi 'phos nas kyang dge slong 'gyur//gal te de ni lhar skyes na//lha yi dge slong srid par 'gyur/ /mir skyes na yang byis pa la/ /blang mi dgos par dge slong 'gyur/ /de la ltung ba byung gyur na//dge slong sdom pa nyams par 'gyur//nyams nas 'chab sems skyes pa la/ /slar yang blang du med par gsungs/ /lha dang byis pa'i dge slong ni/ /'dul ba'i sde snod rnams las bkag

/sems bskyed ldan pa'i bsnyen gnas kyang*/ /nangs par phan chad yod pa'i phyir/ /rtag tu bsnyen gnas bsrung dgos 'gyur/ /min na bsnyen gnas nyams par 'gyur/ /nangs par bsnyen gnas gtong na ni/ /sdom pa rgyun du 'byung ba 'gal/ /des na so sor thar pa yi/ / sdom pa shi yang yod do zhes/ /smra ba'i skyes bu de la ni/ /sde snod rnam dbye med par zad | | bye brag smra ba'i bsnyen gnas kyang*/ /dge slong las len gang zag ni/ /gling gsum skyes pa bud med las/ /'gro ba gzhan la sdom pa bkag /mdo sde pa rnams dud 'gro sogs/ /'gro ba gzhan la'ang skye bar bshad/ /blang pa'i yul dadayang dge bsnyen sogs/ /gang yang rung las blang bar gsungs/ /nyan thos rnams kyi cho ga yang*/ /skyabs su 'gro ba'i tshul gyis 'bogs/ /don yod zhags pa'i rtog pa las | | bsnyen gnas rang gis blang ba yi/ /cho ga sems bskyed 'dra bar gsungs//des na cho ga khyad par yod/ /la la bsnyen gnas bsrungs pa yi/ /nangs par bsnyen gnas 'bul dgos zer/ /bsnyen gnas mtshan mo 'das pa na/ /gtong phyir 'di la 'bul mi dgos/ /mdo sde pa yi lugs bzhin du/ /ji ltar 'dod tshai len na yang*/ /nangs par phan chad bsrung ba yi/ /bsam pa med phyir sdom pa gtong | | de yi phyir na 'bul mi dgos/ /la la bsnyen gnas 'chol ba thos/ /'di 'dra gang na'ang bshad pa med/ kha cig bsnyen gnas 'bogs pa'i tshe/ /nya dang gnam stong tshes brgyad la/ /lha bsgom tha dad ma byas na/ /bsnyen gnas bsrung du mi 'dod zer/ /'di yang rai zhig brtag par bya/ /bsnyen gnas so sor thar pa'i lugs | | gtso cher nyan thos gzhung lugs yin/ /yi dam lha yi bsgom bzlas ni | | gsang sngags pa yi gdams ngag yin//nyan thos gzhung las bshad pa med//des na lha bsgom ma byas kyang*/ /bsnyen gnas nyams par 'gyur ba med/ /'on kyang gsang sngags lugs byed na/ /yi dam bsgom pa bsod nams che/ /theg pa chen po las byung ba'i/

/so sor thar pa bshad kyis nyon/ /byang chub sems dpa' nyid la yang*/ /so sor thar pa 'bogs pa yi/ /cho ga 'ga' zhig yod mod ky-i/ / de yi cho ga phal cher nub/ /gso sbyong rang gis blang ba sogs/ /cho ga'i lag len 'ga' zhig yod/ /rgyal sras byams pa 'jam dbyangs sogs/ /bdag nyid chen po 'ga' zhig gis/ /mkhan po mdzad nas 'gro mang la/ /bsnyen par rdzogs par mdzad do zhes/ /tshig 'bru tsam zhig gsungs mod kyi/ /'on kyang de yi cho ga ni/ /mdo las gsungs pa ngas ma mthong*/ /'di 'dra sngon gyi cho ga ste/ /'phags pa rnams kyi spyod yul yin/ /so so skye bos byar mi rung*/ /des na da lta'i cho ga ni/ /bsam pa sems bskyed kyis zin pa'i/ /cho ga nyan thos lugs bzhin gyis/ /so sor thar pa rigs brgyad po/ /byang sems so sor thar par 'gyur/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' yi/ /so sor thar pa'i bslab bya yi/ khyad par cung zad bshad kyis nyon | | 'di la sdig to mi dge'i phyogs/ /phal cher nyan thos lugs bzhin bsrung | | 'dod pas dben pa'i ltung ba 'ga'/ /byang chub sems dpa'i lugs bzhin bsrung*/ /'jig rten ma dad gyur pa'i cha/ /gnyis ka mthun rnams 'bad pas bsrung*/ /'jig rten 'jug pa'i rgyur 'gyur na/ /theg chen so sor thar la gnang | | dper na nyan thos dge slong na/ /gser dngul len pa thub pas bkag / byang chub sems dpa'i dge slong la/ /gzhan don 'gyur na ltung ba med/ /nyan thos sems can don yin yang*/ / 'dod chen po la ltung ba 'byung*/ /theg chen gzhan gyi don yin na/ /'dod chen ltung ba med ces gsungs/ /so sor thar pa lugs gnyis po//de 'dra'i rnam dbye shes par bya/ /theg chen so sor thar yin yang*/ /dge slong la sogs sdom pa yi/ /ldog pa shi ba'i tshe na gtong*/ /byang chub sems kyi ldog pa dang*/ /de yi 'bras bu shi yang 'byung*/ /de nas las dang rnam smin gyi/ /rnam par dbye ba bshad kyis nyon/

/las la dge sdig lung ma bstan/ /yin zhes rgyal bas mdo las gsungs/ /dge ba legs par spyad pa ste/ /rnam smin bde ba skyed pa yin/ /sdig pa nyes par spyod pa ste/ /rnam smin sdug bsngal skyed par byed/ / btang snyoms gnyis ka ma yin pas/ /rnam par smin pa'ang gnyis ka min/ /'di dag byas ba'i las yin pas/ /'dus byas yin par shes par bya/ /chos kyi dbyings ni 'dus ma byas/ /yin pa'i phyir na las ma yin/ /des na dge dang sdig pa min | | las la thub pas rnam gnyis gsungs/ /sems pa dang ni bsam pa'o/ / sems pa yid kyi las yin te/ /bsam pa de ni lus ngag gi'o/ /chos kyi dbyingasani gnyis ka min/ /de phyir dge sdig las las grol/ /gzhan yang las la rnam bzhi gsungs/ /las dkar rnam smin dkar ba dang*/ /las gnag rnam smin gnag pa dang*/ /las dkar rnam smin gnag pa dang*/ /las gnag rnam smin dkar ba'o// bsam pa dag pa'i sbyin pa sogs/ /gnyis ka dkar bas mkhas pas bya/ /bza' ba'i don du gsod pa sogs/ /gnyis ka gnag pas mkhas pas spang*/ /mang po bskyab phyir gcig gsod sogs/ /las gnag rnam smin dkar na bya/ /gsad phyir sbyin pa gtong la sogs/ /las dkar rnam smin gnag pas spang*/ /gzhan yang las la rnam gnyis gsungs/ /'phen byed las dang rdzogs byed las/ /de dag dbye na mu bzhi yod/ /'phen byed dge bas 'phangs pa la/ /rdzogs byed kyang ni dge ba dang*/ /'phen byed sdig pas 'phangs pa la/ /rdzogs byed kyang ni sdig pa dang*//'phen byed dge la rdzogs byed sdig /'phen byed sdig la rdzogs byed dge /de dag dper brjod mdor bsdus pa/ /bshad par bya yis yid la bzung*/ /mtho risagasum po 'grub pa ni/ /dge ba'i las kyis 'phen pa yin/ /de dag bde ba 'byung ba ni/ /rdzogs byed dge bas 'phangs pa yin/ /ngan song gsum du skye ba ni/ /'phen byed sdig pa yin par gsungs/ /de yi sdug bsngal bye brag kun/

/rdzogs byed las ni sdig pa yin/ /mtho ris dge bas 'phangs mod kyi/ /de yi nad dang gnod pa kun/ /rdzogs byed sdig pa yin par gsungs/ /ngan 'gro'i 'phen byed sdig yin yang*/ /de yi lus sems bde ba yi/ /gnas skabs dge bas 'phangs par gsungs/ /gzhan yang gcig tu dkar ba dang*/ /gcig tu gnag dang 'dren ma'i las/ /rnam pa gsum du thub pas gsungs/ /gcig tu dkar bas bde ba bskyed | | gcig tu gnag pas sdug bsngal bskyed/ /'dren ma'i las kyis bde ba dang*/ /sdug bsngal 'dren ma bskyed par gsungs/ /'di 'dra'i las dang rnam smin gyi/ /rnam par dbye ba shes gyur na/ /da gzod las kyi rgyu 'bras la/ /shin tu mkhas pa nyid du 'gyur/ /mu stegs grangs can pa rnams ni/ /gshis la dge sd-ig yod ces zer/ /rgyu la 'bras bu gnas par 'dod/ /bod kyang la la de rjes 'brang*/ /rdo rje rgyal mtshan bsngo ba las/ /'gro kun dge ba ji snyed yod/ /byas dang byed 'gyur byed pa zhes/ /gsungs pa'i dgongs pa 'chad pa la/ kha cig grangs can lugs bzhin du/ /yod pa'i dge ba zhes bya ba/ /rang byung du ni grub par 'dod/ /de la bde gshegs snying po zer/ /grangs can lugs 'di mi 'thad pas | | lung dang rigs pas dgag par bya/ /bde gshegs snying po zhes bya ba | | chos dbyings 'gyur med nyid la gsungs/ /de skad du yang rgyud bla las | | sems ni rang bzhin 'od gsal ba/ /nam mkha' bzhin du 'gyur med gsung | | mdo las de bzhin gshegs pa yi/ /snying po 'gyur med yin zhes bshad | | klu sgrub kyis kyang dbu ma las/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i rang bzhin gang | | de ni 'gro ba'i rang bzhin yin/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i rang bzhin med | | 'gro ba 'di yi rang bzhin med/ /ces gsungs pa yang de nyid yin/ /shes rab pha rol phyin pa las/ /chos kyi dbyings ni dus gsum dang*/ khams gsum dang ni dge sdig las/ /rnam par grol ba yin zhes gsungs/

/des na chos kyi dbyings la ni/ /bsngo ba med ces rgyal bas bshad/ /yang dag sbyor ba'i rgyud las kyang*/ /de yi sdig dang bsod nams kyi/ /cha gnyis rnam par rtog pa ste/ /mkhas pas 'di gnyis rnam par spang*/ /zhes gsungs de bzhin gsang 'dus la/ /sogs pa'i rgyud sde kun las gsungs/ /'phags pa klu sgrub nyid kyis kyang*/ /gtam bya rin chen phreng ba las/ /sdig dang bsod nams bya ba 'das/ /zab mo bkrol ba'i don dang ldan/ /mu stegs gzhan dang rang nyid kyi'ang | | gnas min skrag pas ma myangs pa/ /zhes gsungs gzhan yang de nyid las | | shes pas yod dang med zhi'i phyir/ /sdig dang bsod nams las 'das pa | | de yis bde 'gro ngan 'gro las/ /de ni thar pa dam par bzhed//ces gsungs 'di yang chos kyi dbyings/ /dge sdig med pa'i lung y-in no/ kha cig bde gshegs snying po'i sgra/ /stong nyid snying rje'i snying por 'dod/ /'di ni bde gshegs snying po'i khams | | sbyong byed yin gyi khams dngos min/ /de skad du yang rnam 'grel las | | sgrub byed thugs rje goms pa las/ /zhes gsungs bslab btus nyid las kyang | | stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can/ /bskyed pas bsod nams dag par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs de bzhin mdo sde dang*/ /rgyud kun las kyang de skad gsungs | | mngon pa'i gzhung las nyan thos rnams/ /ngo bo nyid kyi dge ba zhes | | bshad pa dad pa la sogs pa/ /bcu gcig kho na yin zhes gsung | | don dam dge ba zhes bshad pa/ /de bzhin nyid la gsungs pa yin/ /don dam sdig pa 'khor ba kun/ /nam mkha' so sor brtags min gnyis | | don dam lung ma bstan zhes bshad/ /de bzhin nyid la dge ba zhes// bshad pa'i dgongs pa 'di ltar yin/ /dper na nad dang bral ba ni/ /lus bde mya ngan med pa la/ /sems bde zhes ni 'jig rten zer/ /'di dag sdug bsngal med pa las/ /gzhan pa'i bde ba med mod kyi/ /'on kyang sdug bsngal med tsam la

| | bde ba yin zhes kun la grags/ /de bzhin chos kyi dbyings la yang*/ /sdig pa med pa tsam zhig las/ /lhag pa'i dge ba med mod kyi/ /dge ba yin zhes btags par zad/ /gzhan yang mngon pa'i gzhung rnams las/ /zas kyis 'grangs pa la sogs la/ /'dod chags bral bar gsungs mod kyi/ /'on kyang gtan nas bral ba yi/ /'dod chags bral ba ma yin no/ /de bzhin chos kyi dbyings la yang*/ /dge ba yin zhes gsungs gyur kyang*/ /'bras bu bde ba bskyed pa yi/ /dge ba dngos ni ma yin no/ /ci nas chos dbyings dge ba nyid | | yin na ha cang thal 'gyur te/ /chos kyi dbyings las ma gtogs pa'i | | chos gzhan med phyir sdig pa dang*/ /lung ma bstan yang dge bar 'gyur/ /de lta yin na sems can kun/ /ngan 'gror 'gro ba mi srid do/ /la la byams dang snying rje sogs/ /gshis kyi dge ba yin zhes zer/ /'di yang de ltar nges pa med/ /mi mkhas pa yi byams snying rje/ /ngan song rgyu ru thub pas gsungs | | thabs la mkhas pa'i snying rje la/ /dgongs nas dge bar gsungs pa yin/ /des na 'gro ba thams cad kyis/ /byas pa'i dge ba la dgongs nas

| | 'gro kun dge ba ji snyed yod/ /ces bya'i tshig gis gsungs pa yin/ /gal te chos kyi dbyings yin na/ /ji snyed ces bya'i sgra mi 'thad/ /yod ces bya ba'i sgra yang 'gal/ /de yi rgyu mtshan 'di ltar yin/ /ji snyed ces bya mang po'i sgra/ /chos kyi dbyings la mang nyung med/ /de ni spros bral yin phyir ro | | chos dbyings yod pa'ang ma yin te/ /yod tsam mi rtag gis khyab par/ / chos kyi grags pas legs par gsungs/ /klu sgrub kyis kyang dbu ma las/ /gal te mya ngan 'das dngos na/ /mya ngan 'das pa 'dus byas 'gyur/ /dngos po 'dus byas ma yin pa/ /'ga' yang gang na'ang yod ma yin/ /zhes gsungs gzhan yang de nyid las/ /gang dag rang bzhin gzhan dngos dang*/ /dngos dang dngos med nyid lta ba/ /de dag sangs rgyas bstan pa la/ /de nyid mthong ba ma yin no/ /zhes gsungs gzhan yang de nyid las/ /bcom ldan dngos dang dngos med pa/ /mkhyen pas ka tā ya na yi/ /gdams ngag las ni yod pa dang*/ /med pa gnyis ka dgag par mdzad/ /ces gsungs gzhan yang de nyid las/ /yod ces bya ba rtag par 'dzin/ /med ces bya ba chad par lta/ /de phyir yod dang med pa la/ /mkhas pas gnas par mi bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa yang chos kyi dbyings/ /yod med gnyis ka min pa'i lung*/ /des na sangs rgyas bstan pa la/ /gus par byed na chos kyi dbyings/ /yod med gnyis kar ma bzung shig /rigs pas kyang ni 'di 'grub ste/ /yod tsam don byed nus phyir ro/ /chos kyi dbyings la bya byed med | | de ni spros bral yin phyir ro/ /gzhan yang yod pa'i dge ba ni/ /chos nyid yin na 'gro kun gyi/ /dge ba zhes bya smos ci dgos/ /bems po dang ni dngos med dang*/ /'phags pa'i chos nyid cis mi bsngo/ /thams cad bsngo rgyu yin phyir ro| |des na gzhung de'i dgongs pa ni/ /legs par bshad kyis 'di ltar bzung | | 'gro ba kun gyis byas pa yi/ /dge ba ji snyed yod pa zhes/

/bya ba'i sgra ni spy-ir bstan yin/ /byas dang byed 'gyur byed pa zhes/ /dus gsum dbye ba dmigs bsal yin/ /yang na gzhan gyis byas pa yi/ /dge ba ji snyed yod pa dang*/ /rdo rje rgyal mtshan rang nyid kyis/ /byas dang byed 'gyur byed pa zhes || bshad kyang mdo dang 'gal ba med/ /yang na mdor bstan rgyas bshad do/ /dper na 'gro ba kun gyi sdig /ji snyed yod pa byas pa dang*/ /byed 'gyur de bzhin byed pa rnams/ /rgyal ba'i mdun du bshags par shog /ces bya'i tshig dang mtshungs pa yin/ /'di la'ang dus gsum las gzhan pa'i/ /yod pa'i sdig pa gang yang med/ /de bzhin dus gsum las gzhan pa'i/ /yod pa'i dge ba srid ma yin/ /rdo rje rgyal mtshan nyid las kyang*/ /yod pa zhes bya bsgrub par gsungs/ /chos dbyings dge bar byas nas ni/ /de la bsngo ba'i rgyur byed pa | | bsngo bas 'gyur na 'dus byas 'gyur/ /mi 'gyur bsngo ba don med yin/ /mdo sde rnams las chos kyi dbyings/ /'gyur ba med ces rgyal bas gsungs | | rtsa ba'i shes rab nyid las kyang*/ /rang bzhin rgyu dang rkyen las ni | | 'byung bar rigs pa ma yin no/ /rgyu dang rkyen las byung ba yi/ /rang bzhin byas pa can du 'gyur/ /rang bzhin byas pa can zhes byar/ /ji lta bur na rung bar 'gyur/ /rang bzhin dag ni bcos min dang*/ /gzhan la ltos pa med pa yin/ /zhes gsungs gzhan yang de nyid las/ /gal te rang bzhin gyis yod na | | de ni med nyid mi 'gyur ro/ /rang bzhin gzhan du 'gyur ba ni/ / nam yang 'thad pa ma yin no/ /de la sogs pa'i lung rigs rnams | | chos dbyings dge ba min par gsungs/ /gal te chos nyid de bzhin nyid | | bsngo bya'i dge ba ma yin mod/ /byang chub sems dpa'i blo sbyong la/ /bsngos kyang nyes pa med snyam na/ /ma yin 'di la nyes pa yod/ /dmigs pa'i 'du shes yod pa'i phyir/ /bsngo ba dug dang bcas par 'gyur/ /'di 'dra'i bsngo ba byas gyur na/

/sbal pa rma can ji bzhin du/ /bsngo ba thams cad 'jig par 'gyur/ / chos nyid spros bral ngang nas ni/ /dge ba ji snyed byas pa rnams/ /'grub bam gal te mi 'grub kyang*//'gro ba'i don du sngo byed na//byang chub sems dpa'i blo sbyong yin// chos nyid bsngo rgyur byed na ni/ /blo sbyong du yang mi rung ngo*/ /de yi rgyu mtshan 'di ltar yin/ /chos dbyings spros dang bral ba la/ /dge bar byed na dmigs par 'gyur/ /dmigs dang bcas pa'i 'du shes kyis/ /bsngo ba dug dang bcas par gsungs/ /dper na dug dang bcas pa yi/ kha zas bzang po za ba ltar | | dkar po'i chos la dmigs pa yang*/ /de dang 'dra bar rgyal bas gsungs/ /mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan las kyang*/ /yongs su bsngo ba khyad par can | | de yi byed pa mchog yin no/ /de ni dmigs med rnam pa can/ /phyin ci ma log mtshan nyid do//zhes gsungs mdo rgyud thams cad mthun/ /gang dag dmigs pa med pa yi/ /chos kyi dbyings la'ang yod pa yi/ /dge ba yin zhes dmigs byed pa | | de yi chos can gzhan dag la/ /dmigs par 'gyur ba lta ci smos/ /byi bas dbyug pa'ang zos gyur na/ /snum khur zos pa smos ci dgos/ /gzhan yang chos nyid de bzhin nyid/ /bsngo ba'i yul du byed pa dang*/ /chos nyid mi 'gyur bden pa zhes/ /zer ba gong 'og 'gal ba yin/ /des na legs par soms la smros | | la la bde gshegs snying po'i sgra/ /chos kyi dbyings la mi zer bar | | sems can kho na'i khams la 'dod/ /sems can khams de brtag par bya/ khams de dngos po'am dngos med dam/ /gnyis ka min par spros bral yin/ /rnam pa gsum las gzhan mi srid/ /dngos po yin na bems po dang*/ /rig pa gnyis su kha tshon chod/ /bems po sems can khams nyid du/ /'dod pa mu stegs 'ga' yi lugs/ /yin gyi sangs rgyas pa la med/ /rig pa yin na rnam shes kyi/ /tshogs brgyad nyid las 'da' ba med/

/tshogs brgyad 'dus byas yin pa'i phyir/ /bde gshegs snying por mi 'thad de/ /mdo las bde gshegs snying po ni | | 'dus ma byas su gsungs phyir ro/ /'ga' las zag med sems rgyud ces | | gsungs pa kun gzhi'i rnam shes kyi/ /gsal cha nyid la dgongs pa yin/ /de ni ma bsgribs lung ma bstan/ /yin phyir dge ba'i tha snyad med/ /'on te zag med sems rgyud ces/ /tshogs brgyad las gzhan yod na ni/ /de tshe rnam shes tshogs dgur 'gyur/ /des na tshogs brgyad las gzhan pa'i/ /zag med sems rgyud mi 'thad do/ /dngos med yin na don byed med/ /de la dge sdig 'thad ma yin/ /gal te sems can khams dngos dang*/ /dngos med gnyis ka ma yin par/ /spros bral yin na sngar bshad pa'i/ /chos kyi dbyings las 'da' ba med/ /de lta yin na chos kyi dbyings/ /dge sdig med par bshad zin to/ /gal te bems po'i chos kyi dbyings/ /bde gshegs snying po ma yin yang*/ /sems can rnams kyi chos kyi dbyings/ /bde gshegs snying po yin snyam na/ /ma yin chos kyi dbyings la ni/ /dbye ba med par rgyal bas gsungs | | rigs pas kyang ni 'di 'grub bo/ /des na de bzhin gshegs pa yi | | snying po spros bral yin pa'i phyir/ /sems can rnams la sangs rgyas dang*/ /'khor ba gnyis ka 'byung ba 'thad/ /'phags pa klu sgrub skyob nyid kyis | | gang la stong pa nyid rung ba/ /de la thams cad rung ba yin/ /gang la stong nyid mi rung ba/ /de la thams cad rung ma yin/ /zhes gsungs pa yang don 'di yin | | theg pa chen po rgyud bla mar/ /bde gshegs khams kyi sgrub byed ni | | gal te bde gshegs khams med na/ /sdug la skyo bar mi 'gyur zhing*/ /mya ngan 'das la 'dod pa dang*/ /don gnyer smon pa'ang med par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa yang 'di nyid de/ /nye bar len pa'i phung po lnga/ /sdug bsngal yin zhing mya ngan las/ /'das pa bde ba yin pas na/

/sems ni rang gnas snyeg pa'i phyir | | me yi sgrub byed tsha ba ltar/ /bde gshegs khams kyi sgrub byed 'thad/ /'di don rgyas par brgyad stong pa'i/ /chos 'phags kyi ni le'ur ltos | | 'on kyang mdo sde 'ga' zhig dang*//theg pa chen po rgyud bla mar/ /gos ngan nang na rin chen ltari//sems can rnams la sangs rgyas kyi/ /snying po yod par gsungs pa ni/ /dgongs pa yin par shes par bya/ /de yi dgongs gzhi stong nyid yin/ /dgos pa skyon lnga spang phyir gsungs/ /dngos la gnod byed tshad ma ni | | de 'dra'i sangs rgyas khams yod na/ /mu stegs bdag dang mtshungs pa dang*/ /bden pa'i dngos por 'gyur phyir dang*/ /nges pa'i don gyi mdo sde dang*/ /rnam pa kun tu 'gal phyir ro/ /'di don de bzhin gshegs pa yi/ /snying po'i le'u'i mdo sder ltos/ /slob dpon zla ba grags pas kyang*/ /dbu ma la ni 'jug pa las/ / bde gshegs snying po drang don du/ /gsungs pa de yang shes par gyis/ /'ga' zhig bsngo ba'i tshe na chu/ /sbraing ba'i lag len byed ces grags | | 'di ni mu stegs rig byed pa'i/ /lugs yin sangs rgyas pa la med | | des na gang dang gang byed pa/ /sangs rgyas gsung bzhin gus pas sgrubs | | bsngo ba de yang mdor bsdu na/ /gnas dang gnas ma yin pa gnyis | | gnas kyi bsngo ba 'grub par gsungs/ /gnas min bsngos kyang 'grub mi 'gyur/ /'di dag gnyis ka mdo las gsungs/ /'jam dpal sangs rgyas zhing las ni/ /chos rnams thams cad rkyen bzhin te/ /'dun pa'i rtsa la rab tu gnas | | gang gis smon lam ci btab pa/ /de 'dra'i 'bras bu thob par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs 'di ni gnas la dgongs/ /dri med byin gyis zhus pa'i mdor | | chos rnams chos nyid bsngo ba yis/ /mi 'gyur gal te 'gyur na ni/ /dang po'i sangs rgyas gcig nyid kyi/ /bsngo ba deng sang cis mi 'grub/ /ces gsungs 'di ni gnas min gyi/ / bsngo ba nyid la dgongs pa yin/

/des na bsngo rgyu'i dge ba dang*/ /bshags par bya ba'i sdig pa yang/ /byas pa'i dge sdig yin mod kyi/ /ma byas pa la dge sdig med/ /de yi rnam gzhag bshad kyis nyon/ /'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gsum/ /des bskyed las ni mi dge ba/ /ma chags zhe sdang gti mug med/ /des bskyed las ni dge ba zhes/ /gsungs pa'i dgongs pa shes nas ni/ /mkhas pa rnams kyis dpyad par bya/ /nyan thos dge ba phal cher yang*/ /byang chub sems dpa'i sdig par 'gyur/ /byang chub sems dpa'i dge ba yang*/ /nyan thos sdig tu 'gyur bar gsungs/ /bskal pa du mar dge spyad kyang | | nyan thos sa ru sems bskyed na/ /byang chub sems dpa'i sdig pa lci/ /de ni nyan thos dge chen yin/ /'dod pa'i yon tan lngar spyod kyang*/ /thabs mkhas byang chub sems ldan na/ /rgyal sras rnams kyi dge chen yin/ /nyan thos rnams kyi sdig par gsungs/ /gzhan gyi don gyi sems brtan pa'i/ /pham pa bzhi po spyad na yang*/ /byang chub sems dpa'i dge ba ste/ /nyan thos rnams kyi sdig par gsungs | | 'khor ba'i 'gro la chags pa ni/ /gzhan don yin yang nyan thos kyi | | sdig yin de nyid rgyal sras kyi/ /dge ba yin par shes par bya/ /dkar nag zang thal zhes bya ba'i/ /chos skad ngo mtshar che bar grags/ /de dag gis ni drang don la/ /nges pa'i don du 'khrul par zad/ /ded dpon snying rje chen po yis/ /tshong pa g.yon can bsad pa yi/ /las kyis rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas la | | seng ldeng tshal pa zug pa dang*/ /lo drug dka' ba spyad pa dang*/ /rta chas rul ba gsol ba dang*/ /bram ze'i bu mos skur ba dang*/ /dge 'dun dbyen gyi rgyu la sogs/ /thub pa'i sku tshe snga ma yi/ /las ngan smin par gsungs pa ni | | des 'dul ba yi skye bo la/ /dgongs pa'i dbang gis gsungs pa ste/ /thabs la mkhas pa'i mdo sder ltos/ /de ni nges don mdo sde yin/ /drang ba'i don la yid ma rton/

/gal te rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas la/ /las ngan smin pa bden na ni/ / tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa don med cing*/ /dgra bcom dang yang 'dra bar 'gyur// sku gsum rnam gzhag byar mi rung*/ /de yi 'thad pa bshad kyis nyon/ /tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ni/ /stug po bkod par sangs rgyas pa'i/ / longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku nyid yin/ /de yi sprul pa'i sku nyid ni/ /zas gtsang sras su 'khrungs pa yi/ /shākya seng ge 'di yin no/ /'di ni gdul bya smin pa'i phyir | | gshegs dang bzhugs dang mnal ba dang*/ /mu ge'i grong du gshegs pa dang | | lhung bzed stong par byon pa dang*/ /bsod snyoms mang du rnyed pa dang*/ / dgra dang nye du'i 'brel ba dang*/ /rad rod can du gzims pa dang*/ /res 'ga' bsnyung bar gshegs pa dang*/ /gzhan gyis skur ba sna tshogs dang*/ /res 'ga' snyan pa'i ba dan dang*/ /bde dang dges par spyod pa sogs/ /rnam pa sna tshogs ston pa ni/ /sprul pa yin gyi rang rgyud min/ /gal te sangs rgyas dngos la ni/ /las ngan smin par 'dod na yang*/ /longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku nyid la/ /smin par rigs kyi sprul pa'i sku/ /shākya thub pa la sogs la | | smin par 'dod pa mun sprul yin/ /dper na sgyu ma'i mkhan po la/ /las ngan 'byung gi des sprul pa'i/ /sgyu ma la ni mi 'byung bzhin/ /des na dgongs pa shes dgos so/ /'di yi lung dang rigs pa rnams/ /dbyig gnyen dang ni legs ldan sogs/ /mkhas pa'i gzhung bzhin shes par gyis/ /ye bkag ye gnang zhes bya ba'ang*/ /sangs rgyas bstan dang mthun ma yin/ /nyan thos dang ni theg chen gyi | | gnang bkag thams cad gcig tu med/ /des na la lar gnang ba ni/ /la la'i bkag pa nyid du 'gyur/ /de yi 'thad pa 'di ltar yin/ /rnam dag lung bzhin bshad kyis nyon//nyan thos rtsa ba'i sde bzhi la/ /'dul ba mi 'dra rnam bzhi yod// skad kyang legs sbyar rang bzhin dang*/ /zur chag pa dang sha za'i skad/

/rnam pa bzhi ru gnas pa yin/ /de las gyes pa bco brgyad la/ /'dul ba'i dbye ba'ang bco brgyad yod/ /dang por sdom pa len pa dang*/ /bar du bsrung dang phyir bcos dang*/ /so sor thar pa 'don pa dang*/ /tha mar sdom pa gtong ba'i tshul/ / sde pa thams cad mi mtshungs pas/ /gcig gis bkag pa gcig la gnang*/ / gal te sde pa gcig bden gyi/ /de las gzhan pa brdzun snyam na/ /rgyal po kri kṛ'i rmi lam ltar/ /sde pa thams cad bden par gsungs/ /'di don rgyas par sde pa ni | | tha dad bklag pa'i 'khor lo dang*/ /'dul ba 'od ldan la sogs ltos/ /sde pa kun gyi bslab pa yang*/ /shes na gcig tu 'gyur zhe na/ /shes kyang phal cher tha dad yin/ /dper na thams cad yod smra ba'i/ /mdo sde legs sbyar skad du yod/ /gnas brtan pa dag legs sbyar gyi/ /mdo sde bton na ltung bar byed | | thams cad yod smra rang nyid kyi/ /gsol bzhi'i cho gas sdom pa skye/ /de yi cho ga bzhin byas na/ /sde pa gzhan gyi dge slong 'jig /thams cad yod smra smin ma'i spu/ /bzhar na ltung yin sde pa 'ga'/ /ma bzhar na ni ltung bar 'dod/ /la la bu ram phyi dro 'gog kha cig ltung ba med ces zer/ /la la byin len lag pa bkan

| | la la de las gzhan du byed/ /'ga' zhig lhung bzed byin len byed/ /la la lhung bzed byin len 'gog kha cig mir chags bsad pa la/ /pham pa la la pham pa med/ /la la'i so sor thar pa la/ /gleng gzhi'i tshigs bcad gcig las med | | la la'i ring thung gzhan du yod/ /mdor na pham pa bzhi po nas/ /brtsams te bslab par bya ba kun/ /sde pa thams cad mi mthun pas/ /gang gi bkag la gang gi gnang*/ /dper na bu ram phyi dro'i zas/ / ye gnang yin na sde pa gzhan/ /ltung ba dag dang bcas par 'gyur/ /ye bkag yin na yod smra yi/ /dge slong ltung ba can du 'gyur/ /byin len ma byas za ba yi/ /ltung ba mi skya la 'byung na/ /mi skya'ang dge slong nyid 'gyur bas/ /mi skyas byin len byas na yang*/ /dge slong gis ni dge slong la/ /byin len byas pa ji bzhin du/ /bza' bar rung bar mi 'gyur ro| |de bzhin kun la sbyar bar gyis/ kha cig rab tu byung ba la/ /ltung ba ji snyed 'byung ba de/ khyim pa nas ni dmyal ba'i bar/ /dud 'gro la sogs thams cad la | | ltung ba mtshungs par 'byung zhes zer/ /'di ni sangs rgyas dgongs pa min | | ci phyir zhe na ltung ba de/ /bcas pa phan chad 'byung mod kyi/ /ma bcas pa la ltung med phyir/ /des na thub pas las dang pos/ /nyes pa byas kyang ltung med gsungs/ /de lta min par thams cad la/ /gal te ltung ba kun 'byung na | | 'gro kun ltung ba dang bcas pas/ /thar pa thob pa lta ci smos/ /mtho ris kyang ni 'byung re skan/ /nyan thos rnam gsum dag pa'i sha /bza' rung gal te mi za na | | lhas byin gyi ni brtul zhugs 'gyur/ /theg pa che las sha rnams bkag | zos na ngan 'gro'i rgyu ru gsungs/ /de bzhin pha rol phyin pa dang*/ /gsang sngags kyi ni ltung ba la/ /gnang bkag 'ga' zhig tha dad yod/ /de 'dra'i 'gal ba ltag sprod la/ /ye bkag ye gnang ji ltar rtsi | | des na ye bkag ye gnang gi /rnam gzhag phyogs gcig byar mi rung

| | dper na pad+ma'i so nam la/ /rtag tu 'dam dang ljan ljin dgos/ /shu dag sogs kyis bskor na skye/ /me tog gzhan la de mi dgos/ /chu las skye la skam sa dgra/ /skam sar skye la rlon pa dgra/ /grang sar dro ba'i rdzas mi smin/ /dro sar bsil ba 'thad ma yin/ /des na bya ba gang ci'ang rung | | rang rang lugs bzhin byas na 'grub/ /de las bzlog pa'i lugs byas na | | mi 'grub grub kyang bzang po dka'/ /de bzhin gnang bkag thams cad kyang | | rang rang lugs bzhin byas na 'grub/ /gal te sdom pa ma blangs na/ /ltung ba'i tha snyad mi thob kyang*/ /rab tu byung la bcas pa yi/ /sdig pa khyim pa la yang 'byung*/ /de lta min par rab byung la/ /ched du byas nas sdig bsgo na/ /thub pas rab tu byung ba la/ /snying nad byas par 'gyur zhes zer/ /'di 'dra'i rigs pa gzu lums yin/ /'o na zhing yod rnams la yang*/ /ser ba la sogs 'byung 'gyur gyi | | zhing med rnams la mi 'byung bas/ /zhing bzang byin pa'ang snying nad 'gyur/ /des na zhing la dgra yod kyang*/ /lo thog 'byung ba'i phan yon yod/ /de bzhin rab tu byung ba la/ /ltung ba srid mod phan yon che/ /dper na sprang por ser ba sogs/ / mi 'jigs mod kyi lo thog med/ /de bzhin khyim pa rnams la yang*/ /ltung ba med mod dge mi 'byung*/ /des na mdo dang bstan bcos las/ /rang bzhin kha na ma tho dang*/ /bcas pa'i kha na ma tho ba/ /rnam pa gnyis su bsdus te gsungs/ /rang bzhin kha na ma tho ba/ /sems can kun la sdig par 'gyur/ /bcas pa'i kha na ma tho ba/ /bcas pa phyin chad ltung bar 'gyur/ /de lta min par ma bcas kyang/ /ci nas sdig par 'gyur na ni/ /rgyal ba rigs lnga la sogs pa/ /longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku rnams dang*/ /nye ba'i sras brgyad la sogs pa*/ /byang chub sems dpa' phal cher yang*/ /dbu skra ring zhing rgyan dang bcas/ kha dog sna tshogs na bza' can | | phyag mtshan sna tshogs 'dzin pa rnams/

/ye bkag pa la spyod pa'i phyir/ / gshis kyis mi dge can du 'gyur/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug bir+wa pa/ /ti lo nā ro la sogs pa/ /dge slong brtul zhugs bor ba yi/ /grub thob rnams kyang sdig can 'gyur/ /tsan+dan spos kyi ngad ldan pa'i/ /dge slong ji snyed thams cad kyang*/ / rgyan dang bcas shing gos dkar ba/ /de dag kyang ni sdig can 'gyur/ /gshis kyis mi dge spyod phyir ro/ /dge bsnyen dge tshul sdom brtson la'ang*/ /sdig med srid par mi 'gyur te/ /de dag la yang dge slong gi /ltung ba thams cad 'byung phyir ro | | 'di 'dra gang dag su zer ba/ /de yis rang gi rtsa ba dang*/ /brgyud pa'i bla mar gang gyur pi/ khyim pa'am ni dge bsnyen nam/ /rnal 'byor pa ru gang bzhugs pa | | de dag thams cad smad pa ste/ /gshis kyis mi dge mdzad phyir dang*/ /ltung ba thams cad spyod phyir ro/ /des na mdo las brtul zhugs la/ /dge sdig gnyis ka med par gsungs/ /zhing gi grab bzhin tshul khrims la/ /gus pa'i rgyu ru gsungs par zad/ /des na 'dod pas dben pa dang*/ /sdig to mi dge'i chos kyis ni/ /dben pa zhes bya rnam gnyis gsungs/ /thub pa'i dgongs pa ji bzhin zungs | | bu mo gser mchog 'od dpal gyis/ /blo gros chen po 'jam dpal la | | rab tu 'byung bar zhus pa'i tshe/ /lus kyi rab byung bkag nas kyang*/ /sems kyi rab byung thob par mdzad/ /gal te gshis la dge yod na/ /lus la ngur smig cis mi bskon/ /dkon mchog brtsegs pa'i mdo sde las/ /dad rdzas za ba'i nyes mthong nas/ /dge slong lnga brgyas sdom pa phul/ /de la thub pas legs zhes gsungs | | 'phags pa byams pa'i bstan pa la/ /'dus pa dang por de lung bstan | | des na sdom pa dge ba yin/ /cha lugs tsam la dge ba med/ /sdom pa med pa'i cha lugs kun/ /mdo dang bstan bcos rnams las bkag /gshis la dge ba yod na ni/ /sdom pa med kyang rab byung gi

/cha lugs tsam re cis mi gzung*/ /'di 'dra'i chos lugasabastan pa min/ /de la kha cig 'di skad du/ /gal te gshis la dge ba dang*/ /sdig pa gnyis ka med pa la/ /thub pas ltung ba 'cha' na ni/ /bde sdug kun gyi byed pa po/ /sangs rgyas yin par 'gyur ce na/ /'di yi lan la rnam gnyis las/ /mgo bsgre'i lan ni 'di ltar yin/ /gshis la dge sdig yod na ni/ khyed kyang mu stegs 'ga' zhig ltar/ /ngo bo nyid rgyur smra bar 'gyur/ /gnyis pa dngos po'i lan la ni/ / gshis la dge dang sdig med kyang | | bde sdug las kyis byas pa yin/ /las kyi byed po sems nyid yin/ /sems ni dge dang mi dge ba'i/ /stobs kyis las la bzang ngan 'byung*/ /bzang ngan de las bde sdug 'byung*/ /de dag blang dor byed pa yi/ /thabs ni sdom pa'i tshul khrims yin/ /brtul zhugs tshul khrims bsrung ba'i thabs/ /de la gang la gang dgos pa'i/ /bslab pa 'cha' ba'i byed pa po| | rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nyag gcig yin/ /des na bsam pa'i khyad par gyis | | gnyen po'i bye brag du ma yod/ /de yi thabs su brtul zhugs dang*/ / 'dul ba'i bcas pa mi 'dra ba/ /mdzad pa'i rgyu mtshan de ltar yin/ /des na bde dang sdug bsngal gyi/ /byed po sangs rgyas ma yin yang*/ /bslab pa 'cha' dang sngags sbyor ba'i/ /byed po sangs rgyas yin par gsungs/ /sbu gu can dang gong ba can/ /rta la zhon pa la sogs dang/ /lag nya dang ni nub tshangs sogs/ /'dul ba'i spyod pa ma yin pa/ /byas pa kun la mnong pa yi/ /tshul gyis bshags pa legs par bya/ /de dag ltung ba med do zhes | | smra na bstan la gnod pa yin/ /rab tu byung ba 'bab pa dang*/ /phan tshun rtsod par byed pa dang*/ /dam chos nyo tshong byed pa dang*/ /dge sbyong phyi dro za ba dang*/ /chang 'thung ba la sogs pa dang*/ /chos gos lhung bzed med pa sogs/ /chos dang 'gal ba'i spyod pa kun/ /ltung ba med ces sgrogs pa dang*/

/bla ma'i zhabs tog yin pa dang*/ /sangs rgyas bstan la phan pa sogs/ /smra na bstan pa spy-i la gnod/ /rang gis bsgrub par ma nus pa'am | | las ngan yin zhes smra na ni/ /rang la gnod kyi bstan la min/ /gal te skye ba snga ma yi/ /las ngan smin pa'i shugs nyid las/ /chos dang 'gal ba'i spyod pa kun/ /dbang med bya dgos byung na yang*/ /'di ni chos min 'dul ba min | | sangs rgyas bstan pa'ang min no zhes/ /mnong ba'i tshul gyis legs par bshags/ /'di dag chos dang mi 'gal zhing*/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa yin no zhes | | smra na sangs rgyas bstan la gnod// des na bstan pa'i sgor zhugs pas | | sangs rgyas bstan la ma phan yang*/ /rnam pa kun tu gnod mi bya/ /mdo bskul la sogs bya ba kun/ /'dul ba'i gzhung dang mthun par gyis/ /mdo bskul ring mo zhes bya ba/ /dka' la nor ba byed pa mthong*/ /mdo rgyud kun las 'di ma gsungs/ /'di 'dra'i rigs kyi chos 'phel na/ /bstan pa'i rtsa ba nub par 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas gsungs pa'i cho ga kun/ /sla bar gyur kyang mi byed la | | sangs rgyas kyis ni ma gsungs na/ /dka' yang 'bad nas byed pa mtshar/ /sangs rgyas gsung dang mi mthun yang*/ /'di 'dra bden par 'dod na ni | | lag len phyin ci log gzhan yang*/ /'khrul zhes brjod par mi nus te | | lung dang 'gal ba'i chos yin par/ /rang bzor thams cad mtshungs pa la | | 'ga' zhig bden la 'ga' zhig ni/ /brdzun pa yin zhes dpyad mi rung | | mu stegs la sogs chos log kyang*/ /sun dbyung bar ni mi nus te/ /lung rigs med par mtshungs pa la/ /bden rdzun dbye ba nus ma yin/ /la la rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi/ /gsung rab tshig don zab mo dang*/ /grub thob rnams dang mkhas rnams kyi/ /shin tu legs par bshad pa'i chos/ /tshig gi na ya yin pas na | | dgos pa med pas dor zhes zer/ /tshig kyang bsgrigs legs mi shes na | | don bzang smos kyang ci dgos pa'i/

/blun po rnams kyi rang dga'i tshig | mkhas rnams bzhad gad bskyed pa yi/ /'brel med sna tshogs bris pa la | | bstan bcos yin zhes nyan bshad byed/ /blun po dga' ba bskyed nus kyi| | mkhas rnams dga' ba bskyed mi nus/ /dus dang blo gros gron du 'gyur/ /kye ma sangs rgyas bstan pa ni/ /'di ltar gyur pa da gzod go | des na sangs rgyas gsung rab dang*/ /mkhas pa rnams kyi bstan bcos kyi | | tshig don la ni byin rlabs yod/ /'di 'dra nyan bshad byed pa la/ /thos pa zhes ni brjod pa yin/ /de don dpyod pa bsam pa yin/ /nan tan gyis ni de bsgrub pa/ /bsgom pa yin par shes par bya/ /thos bsam bsgom gsum de ltar gyis// 'di ni sangs rgyas bstan pa yin/ /so sor thar ba'i sdom pa'i skabs te dang po'au// //sems bskyed la ni nyan thos dang*/ /theg pa chen po'i lugs gnyis yod/ /nyan thos rnams la sems bskyed gsum/ /dgra bcom rang rgyal sangs rgyas so/ /nyan thos bstan pa nub pas na/ /de yi cho gar spyod pa nyung | | theg pa chen po'i sems bskyed la/ /dbu ma sems tsam rnam pa gnyis/ /de gnyis lta ba tha dad pas/ /cho ga yang ni tha dad yin/ /ltung ba dang ni phyir bcos dang*/ /bslab par bya ba'ang so sor yod/ /sems tsam pa yi sems bskyed 'di/ /bod na byed pa mang mod kyi/ /de ni su yang rung ba yi/ /gang zag rnams la byar mi rung*/ /la la skye bo 'ga' zhig gi /rmi lam gyi ni rjes 'brangs nas | | sems can kun la sems skyed byed/ /rmi lam bdud kyi min na rung*/ /byang chub sems dpa'i sa dang ni/ /mar me mdzad kyis bkag phyir dang*/ /cho ga las kyang gsal ba'i phyir/ /lugs de sangs rgyas bstan pa min/ kha cig blun po sdig pa can/ /yin yang der 'tshogs thams cad ni/ /so sor thar pa'i sdom pa can/ / byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod la/ /mkhas pa sha stag yin no lo/ /'di 'dra'i tshig la'ang bden 'dzin yod/

/sems yod rnams kyis 'di la dpyod/ /gal te 'di 'dra'i tshig bden na/ /de las mi bden gzhan ci yod/ /des na chos kyi rjes 'brangs pa'i/ /mkhas pa rnams kyis lugs 'di spongs/ /dbu ma'i lugs kyi sems bskyed 'di/ /sems can kun gyis legs thob na/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi rgyur 'gyur zhes/ /mdo dang bstan bcos rnams las gsungs/ / de yang sdong po bkod pa dang*/ /bskal bzang nam mkha'i snying po dang*/ /dkon brtsegs rgyal po gdams pa yi/ /mdo sde la sogs rnams su ltos/ /'phags pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad dang*/ /rgyal sras zhi ba lhas mdzad pa'i/ /bstan bcos la sogs rnams las gsungs/ /ji ltar 'bras kyi sa bon ni/ /grang ba'i yul du mi skye ba/ /de bzhin sems tsam pa yi yang*/ /sems bskyed sdig can la mi skye/ /ji ltar nas kyi sa bon ni/ /grang dro gang du'ang skye ba ltar/ /de bzhin dbu ma'i sems bskyed kyang || sdig pa yod med kun la skye//gal te mdo las bshad pa yi//gzhung de sems tsam pa yi yang*/ /sems bskyed lung du ci 'gal zhes/ /snyam na de ni 'khrul pa yin/ /rgyal ba phan bzhed nyin gcig gi /srog gcod sdom pa blangs pa la | | byang chub sems dpa'i sems bskyed mdzad/ /de ni so sor thar pa min/ /de la sogs pa'i 'thad pa rnams/ /dbu ma'i lugs la 'thad mod kyi/ /sems tsam pa yi lugs la min/ /des na sems tsam pa yi lugs/ /gal te sems bskyed de 'dod na/ /thog mar so sor thar pa longs/ /byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod slobs/ /dad cing bsgrub par nus gyur na/ /phyi nas sems bskyed sdom pa longs | | ci ste sems can thams cad la/ /sangs rgyas sa bon 'jog 'dod na | | cho ga 'khrul pa med pa yi/ /dbu ma pa yi gzhung bzhin gyis | | don dam sems bskyed ces bya ba/ /bsgoms pa'i stobs kyis skye mod kyi| | cho ga'i sgo nas 'di mi skye/ /gal te cho gas skye na ni/

/brda las byung ba'i sems bskyed 'gyur/ /'di ni don dam chos nyid kyis/ /thob pa zhes bya'i sems bskyed yin/ /'di la sbyor dngos rjes gsum gyi/ /cho ga rgyal bas gsungs pa med/ /mkhas pa thams cad 'di mi mdzad/ /mdzad kyang cho gar mi 'gyur ro/ /des na 'di 'dra'i rigs can kun/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa'i gzugs brnyan yin/ /dper na chu lud sa bon sogs/ /so nam zhing pas byar nus kyi/ /myu gu sdong bu snye ma sogs/ /zhing las 'byung gi mi las min/ /de bzhin kun rdzob byang chub sems/ /cho ga'i sgo nas bskyed nus kyi/ /don dam byang chub sems dang ni/ /zag pa med pa'i sdom pa dang*/ /bsam gtan gyi ni sdom pa sogs/ /ngang gis skye yis cho gas min/ /'di dag 'thad pa dang bcas pa | | mdo dang bstan bcos kun las 'byung*/ /don dam sems bskyed bya'o zhes | | gal te brgya la gsungs srid kyang/ /dam bca' yin gyi cho ga min/ /dper na sbyin pa gtang bar bya/ /tshul khrims dam pa bsrung bar bya/ /sangs rgyas yon tan bsgrub par bya/ /de la sogs pa gsungs pa kun/ /dam bca'i tshig tsam nyid yin gyi/ /cho ga'i sgo nas bskyed pa min/ /yin na ha cang thal 'gyur zhing*/ /cho ga yang ni thug med 'gyur/ /kye ma 'jig rten blun po 'di/ / rgyal bas gsungs pa kun bor nas/ /ma gsungs nan gyis 'tshang ba ni/ /'di 'dra cir 'gyur brtag dgos so/ /de ltar sems tsam dbu ma gnyis/ /rnam gzhag tha dad yod mod kyi/ /'on kyang theg chen kun mthun par/ /ltung ba'i rnam gzhag mu bzhi gsungs/ /ltung med ltung dang ltung ba yi/ /gzugs brnyan ltung ba med pa yi/ /gzugs brnyan zhes bya rnam pa bzhi/ /bsam pa dag pa'i sbyin pa sogs/ /rnam pa kun tu ltung ba med/ /bsam pa ngan pa'i srog gcod sogs/ /rnam pa kun tu ltung bar 'gyur/ /dge ba'i sems kyis bsad pa sogs/ /ltung ba'i gzugs brnyan yin zhes gsungs/

/gzhan la gnod na brdzun min yang*/ /ltung ba med pa'i gzugs brnyan yin/ /mdor na sems kyi 'phen pa las/ /gzhan pa'i dge sdig yod ma yin/ /'phags pa lha yis bzhi brgya par/ /bsam pas byang chub sems dpa' yi/ /dge ba'am yang na mi dge ba

| | thams cad dge ba nyid 'gyur te/ /gang phyir sems de gtso ba'i phyir/ / zhes gsungs mdo rgyud gzhan las kyang*/ /dge sdig rnam gzhag de ltar gsungs | | byang chub sems kyi bslab pa la/ /bdag gzhan mnyam brje gnyis su gsungs | kha cig brje ba'i byang chub sems/ /bsgom du mi rung zhes su smra/ /de yi rgyu mtshan 'di skad lo/ /bdag bde gzhan la byin nas ni/ /gzhan sdug bdag gis blangs gyur na/ /smon lam mtha' ni btsan pa'i phyir/ /bdag ni rtag tu sdug bsngal 'gyur/ /des na 'di 'dra'i byang chub sems/ /bsgom pa de dag thabs mi mkhas | | nor ba chen po'i chos yin lo/ /de don 'di ltar bsam par bya/ /bdag gzhan brje ba'i byang chub sems/ /dge ba yin nam sdig yin brtag /gal te dge ba yin na ni/ /de las sdug bsngal 'byung ba 'gal/ / sdig pa yin na dug gsum gyis/ /bskyed pa'i las su thal bar 'gyur/ /brje ba dug gsum ma yin pas | | de las sdug bsngal ga la 'byung*/ /byang chub sems dpa'i blo sbyong ba'i| | smon lam 'ga' zhig mtha' mi btsan/ /gal te btsan na mdza' bo'i bu | | rgyun du klad nad chen por 'gyur/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyang | | bdag gzhan brje ba bsgom pa'i phyir/ /rgyun du sdug bsngal thob par 'gyur/ /brjes pa'i sems can de dag kun/ /sdug bsngal 'byung ba srid mi 'gyur/ /des na 'di 'dra'i gsang tshig ni/ /bdud kyi yin pa mi shes so/ /thabs la bslu ba'i bdud yod ces/ /rgyal bas gsungs pa'ang dran par bya/ /bdag gzhan brje ba sangs rgyas kyi/ /bstan pa'i snying po yin par gsungs/ /'phags pa klu sgrub skyob nyid kyis/ /rin chen phreng bar 'di skad gsungs/ /bdag la de dag sdig smin cing/ /bdag dge ma lus der smin shog | ji srid sems can 'ga' zhig kyang*/ /gang du ma grol de srid du/ /de phyir bla na med pa yi/ /byang chub thob kyang gnas gyur cig

/de skad brjod pa'i bsod nams 'di/ /gal te de ni gzugs can 'gyur/ /gaṅgā'i bye ma snyed kyi ni | | 'jig rten khams su shong mi 'gyur/ /'di ni bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs | | gtan tshigs kyang ni 'di la snang*/ /de la sogs pa legs par gsungs | | spyod 'jug las kyang 'di skad du/ /bdag bde gzhan gyi sdug bsngal dag /yang dag brje bar ma byas na/ /sangs rgyas nyid du mi 'grub cing | | 'khor ba na yang bde ba med/ /de skad gsungs pa legs par bzung*// mdo dang bstan bcos gzhan las kyang*/ /chos kyi snying por 'di gsungs so/ /des na bdag gzhan brje ba shes/ /de ni myur du rdzogs 'tshang rgya/ /de yi bar du'ang 'jig rten gyi/ /phun sum tshogs pa 'byung bar gsungs/ /byang chub sems kyi gnad 'chugs na/ /chos gzhan gyis ni 'tshang mi rgya | | stong nyid nyan thos rnams kyang bsgom/ /de yi 'bras bu 'gog pa thob/ /so sor thar pa'i mdo bzhin du/ /bsngo ba nyan thos rnams kyang byed | | 'dul ba lung la sogs pa ru/ /stong pa nyid dang skye med dang*/ /mkha' dang lag mthil mnyam pa sogs/ /chos kun mnyam nyid rtogs pa'ang gsungs/ /bdag gis bram ze 'dod pa la/ /dga' bas shing rta 'di btang bas | | dngos po thams cad btang nas ni/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par shog | de sogs bsngo ba mang du gsungs/ /'on kyang thabs la mkhas pa yi/ khyad par 'ga' zhig ma gsungs pas/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bsgrub mi nus/ /de phyir thabs mkhas shes rab nyid/ /sangs rgyas rgyu yi gtso bo yin/ /sangs rgyas dgongs pa mi shes par/ /chos ltar bcos pas blun po 'ga'/ /ngo mtshar bskyed kyi mkhas pa rnams/ khrel bar 'gyur ba 'di 'dra yod/ /chang dang dug dang mtshon cha dang*/ /gzhan gyi longs spyod ster ba dang*/ /gsod sar phyugs ma ster ba dang*/ /mchog gi nor ni mchog min la/ /ster sogs mdo las bkag pas na | | ma dag pa yi sbyin pa yin/

/nyan thos kyi ni sdom pa la/ /theg pa chen por 'chos pa dang*/ /de bzhin theg chen nyan thos su/ /'chos pa tshul khrims ma dag pa/ /rang nyid tshul khrims bsrungs na yang*/ /tshul khrims la ni mchog 'dzin cing*/ /gzhan la khyad gsod byed pa ni/ /ma dag pa yi tshul khrims yin/ /dkon mchog gsum dang bla ma la/ /gnod cing bstan pa 'jig pa la | khros na ldog par nus bzhin du/ / bzod pa bsgoms na ma dag pa'o/ /log pa'i chos la dga' ba dang*/ /thos bsam bsgom gsum nor ba la/ /brtson 'grus chen po byed pa sogs/ /ma dag pa yi brtson 'grus yin/ /mi mkhas stong nyid bsgom pa dang*/ /gnad 'chugs pa yi thabs lam sogs/ /rnam rtog 'ga' zhig 'jil ba dang*/ /ting 'dzin phra mo skyed pa'i thabs/ /dad pa chen pos bsgoms na yang*/ /yang dag ye shes mi skye bas/ /ma dag pa yi bsgom pa yin/ /sangs rgyas gsung dang mi mthun pa'i/ /'chad rtsod rtsom la mkhas gyur cing | | bya ba thams cad shes gyur kyang*/ /ma dag pa yi shes rab yin/ bla ma ngan la dad pa dang*/ /chos ngan pa la mos pa dang*/ /bsgom ngan pa la dga' ba ni | | ma dag pa yi dad pa yin/ /nad pa dga' ba'i kha zas ster/ /ngan par spyod pa tshar mi gcod/ /dbang bskur med par gsang sngags ston/ /snod min pa la chos 'chad sogs/ /'phral la phan pa ltar snang yang*/ /phyi nas gnod pa cher 'gyur bas/ /snying rje'i dbang gis byed na yang*/ /ma dag pa yi snying rje yin/ /gdug pa can la byams pa dang*/ /bu dang slob ma mi 'chos dang*/ /srung ba'i 'khor lo mi bsgom zhing*/ khro bo'i bzlas pa 'gog pa sogs/ /rgyud sde kun dang 'gal bas na/ /ma dag pa yi byams pa yin/ /mdo rgyud kun las ma gsungs shing*/ /rigs pas bsgrub par mi nus pa/ /drod dang bde ba skye ba dang*/ /mi rtog ltar snang skye ba sogs/ / nad gdon cung zad sel ba dag /blun po dga' ba bskyed na yang*/ /mu stegs byed la'ang yod pa'i phyir

| | ma dag pa yi thabs lam yin/ /bdag lta'i rtsa ba ma chod cing | | 'khor 'das gnyis la smon pa can/ /dge ba la ni ngo mtshar blta | | chos kun spros bral mi shes pas/ /sangs rgyas nyid du bsngo na yang*/ / ma dag pa yi smon lam yin/ /de la sogs pa mtha' yas pa/ /sangs rgyas gsung gi gnad 'chugs pas/ /dge bar byed par snang na yang*/ /ma dag pa ru shes par gyis | | mdor na sangs rgyas gsung rab dang*/ /mthun pa'i thos bsam bsgom pa gsum | | bsam pa dag pas sgrub byed na/ /sangs rgyas bstan par shes par bya | | byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa'i skabs te gnyis pa'au// //rdo rje theg pa'i lam zhugs te/ /myur du sangs rgyas thob 'dod na/ /smin grol gnyis la 'bad par bya/ /smin par byed pa'i dbang bskur yang*/ /bla ma brgyud pa ma nyams shing*/ /cho ga 'khrug par ma gyur pa/ /phyi nang rten 'brel bsgrig mkhyen cing*/ /sku bzhi'i sa bon thebs nus pa/ /sangs rgyas gsung bzhin mdzad pa yi/ /bla ma btsal la dbang bzhi blang*/ /de yis sdom pa sum ldan 'gyur/ /deng sang rdo rje phag mo yi/ /byin rlabs dbang bskur yin zhes zer | | 'di yis chos kyi sgo phye nas/ /gtum mo la sogs bsgom pa mthong | | 'di 'dra rgyud sde las ma gsungs/ /bstan bcos rnams las bshad pa med | | rdo rje phag mo nyid las kyang*/ /dbang bskur thob cing dam tshig ldan/ /de la byin rlabs bya zhes gsungs/ /dbang bskur med la byin rlabs bkag /dper na mu zi'i bcud len 'ju/ /de nas dngul chu bza' bar gsungs/ /mu zi thog mar ma brtain par/ /dngul chu zos na 'chi ba ltar/ /de bzhin thog mar dbang bskur blang*/ /de nas rdo rje phag mo sbyin/ /dbang bskur med par byin brlabs na | | dam tshig nyams par thub pas gsungs/ /rdo rje phag mo'i byin rlabs la/ /sdom pa gsum ldan byar mi rung*/ /phyi nang rten 'brel 'grig mi 'gyur/ /sku bzhi'i sa bon thebs mi nus/

/de phyir 'di ni byin rlabs tsam/ / yin gyis sm-in par byed pa min/ /des na thub pas rgyud sde las/ /dkyil 'khor chen po ma mthong ba'o| | mdun du 'di ni ma smra zhig /smras na dam tshig nyams zhes gsungs | | 'ga' zhig 'di la'ang phag mgo la/ /sogs pa'i dbang bskur yod ces zer/ /de 'dra dbang bskur nyid ma yin/ /rgyud sde kun las 'di ma gsungs | | gal te brgya la gsungs srid kyang*/ /rjes gnang yin gyi dbang bskur min || la la rdo rje phag mo la//sdom pa 'bogs pa'i cho ga dang*/ /dkyil 'khor dang ni dbang bskur sogs/ /rang bzo'i cho ga byed pa thos/ / rang bzos cho gar 'gyur mi srid/ /cho ga sangs rgyas spyod yul yin/ khyim pas gsol bzhi'i las byas kyang*/ /dge slong sdom pa mi 'chags ltar/ /rdo rje phag mo'i byin rlabs la | | sdom pa phog kyang chags mi 'gyur/ /cho ga cung zad nyams pa la'ang*/ /cho ga 'chags par ma gsungs na/ /cho ga phal cher nyams pa la/ / cho ga 'chags par 'gyur re skan/ /des na 'chad pa'i gnas skabs su/ /cung zad nor bar gyur kyang bla'i/ /cho ga nor bar gyur pa la/ /grub pa nam yang med par gsungs | | gzhan yang phag mo'i byin rlabs la/ /gsang sngags chos sgor byed pa ni | | rgyud sde gang na'ang bshad pa med/ /de bas dge slong byed pa la/ /rang byung gi ni bsnyen rdzogs dang*/ /ye shes khong du chud pa dang*/ /'phrin gyis bsnyen par rdzogs pa dang*/ /de bzhin ston par khas blangs dang*/ /tshur shog la sogs bsnyen rdzogs blang*/ /'khrul pa yin pa mnyam po la/ /'di rnams sngon gyi cho gar bshad | | des na nyan thos theg pa ni/ /nub kyang gzugs brnyan tsam zhig snang || rdo rje theg pa'i bstan pa la//gzugs brnyan tsam yang mi snang ngo/ /blun po snying phod can gyis kyang*/ /'dul ba'i cho ga brgal ma nus// gsang sngags cho ga thams cad la/ /blun po rnams kyis rang bzor spyod/ / dper na rab byung gang zag ni/

/gsum las mang ba 'jug mi nus/ /sngags kyi dbang bskur byed pa na | | grangs nges med par dbang bskur byed/ /'di ni rdo rje 'chang gis bkag | spyod pa'i rgyud kyi dbang bskur la/ /slob ma grangs nges med par gsungs | | lhag ma dmigs bsal mdzad pa yi/ /slob ma la ni grangs nges yod/ /'di ni gsang ba spyi rgyud las/ /mkhas pas slob ma gcig gam gsum | | lnga 'am yang na bdun dag gam/ /nyi shu rtsa ni lnga yi bar/ /zung du ma gyur slob ma gzung*/ /de bas lhag pa'i slob ma ni/ /yongs su gzung bar mi shis so/ /zhes gsungs 'di ni kun la 'jug /de bas lhag pa'i slob ma la/ / cho ga yongs su rdzogs pa ni/ /mtshan mo gcig la tshar mi nus/ /de yi mtshan mor ma tshar na/ /cho ga nyams par 'gyur bar gsungs/ /de yang gsang ba spyi rgyud las | | lha yang nyi ma nub pa na/ /nges par byin gyis rlabs kyis 'du/ /nyi ma shar bar ma gyur bar/ /mchod nas gshegs su gsol ba shis/ /'di ni bya ba'i rgyud yin pas/ /gzhan gyi cho ga min snyam na/ /gzhan rnams kun la'ang 'di 'jug par/ /spyi rgyud nyid las 'di skad gsungs/ /gang du las ni yod gyur la/ /las kyi cho ga rnams med pa/ /der ni spyi yi rgyud dag las/ /gsungs pa'i cho ga mkhas pas bsten/ /de skad gsungs phyir cho ga 'di/ /rgyud rnams kun la 'jug pa yin/ /deng sang byin rlabs mi byed cing*/ /dbang bskur byed pa kha cig kyang*/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa yi/ /dkyil 'khor cho ga mi byed par | | g.yung drung ris kyi dkyil 'khor dang*/ /nas 'dra la sogs byed pa thos/ /'di 'dra dag tu dbang bskur yang*/ /sdom pa thob par mi 'gyur ro| | de yi rgyu mtshan bshad kyis nyon/ /phyi dang nang gi rten 'brel gyi/ /stobs kyis dkyil 'khor 'byung ba yin/ /'di la rten 'brel bsgrig mi nus/ /des na sangs rgyas rnams kyis bkag /dbang bskur byed pa phal cher yang*/

/slob ma brgya stong grangs med la/ /sbyor dngos rjes kyi cho ga rnams/ /sangs rgyas gsungs bzhin mi shes par/ /ma 'brel 'gal zhing nyams pa yi/ /cho ga'i gzugs brnyan byed pa la/ /dbang bskur yin zhes blun po smra/ /de yi lus ngag yid gsum gyi | | rnam pa gdon gyis bsgyur ba la/ /byin rlabs yin par 'khrul pa mang | | dpal ldan dam pa dang po las/ /cho ga nyams pa'i byin rlabs kun// bgegs kyis yin par rgyal bas gsungs/ /cho ga dag par gyur pa las/ /byung ba sangs rgyas byin rlabs yin/ /dbang bskur med kyang lam zab mo/ /bsgoms na sangs rgyas 'grub snyam na/ /dbang bskur med par lam zab mo/ /bsgom pa ngan 'gro'i rgyu ru gsungs/ /phyag rgya chen po thig le las/ /dbang med na ni dngos grub med/ /byai ma btsir yang mar med bzhin/ /gang zhig rgyud lung nga rgyal gyis | | dbang bskur med par 'chad byed pa/ /slob dpon slob ma shi ma thag /dngos grub thob kyang dmyal bar skye/ /de bas 'bad pa thams cad kyis | | bla ma las ni dbang nod zhu/ /zhes gsungs rgyud sde gzhan las kyang*/ /de ltar gsungs phyir 'bad par bya/ kha cig gang zag dbang po rab/ /smin byed phag mo'i byin rlabs yin/ /'bring dang tha ma dag la ni/ /dbang bskur cho ga dgos zhes zer/ /gang zag rab 'bring gsum ka la/ /phag mo'i byin rlabs smin byed du/ /rgyud sde kun las gsungs pa med/ /'phags pa rnams kyis gang zag rab | | sprul pa yi ni dkyil 'khor du/ /dbang bskur mdzad ces gsungs pa ni | | sngon gyi cho ga 'phags pa'i yin/ /deng sang gang zag rab 'bring kun/ / rdul tshon gyi ni dkyil 'khor du/ /dbang bskur bya bar gsungs mod kyi/ /gzhan gyi smin byed rgyud las bkag /la la sems bskyed byas pa la/ /gsang sngags bsgom du 'dod ces zer/ /'di ni sngags kyi 'khrul yin lo/ /'di yang phye ste bshad kyis nyon/ /bya ba'i rgyud la rnam gsum yod//don yod zhags sogs 'ga' zhig la/

/dbang bskur sems bskyed ma thob kyang*/ /smyung gnas la sogs byed nus na/ /gang zag kun gyis bsgrub par gsungs/ /dam tshig gsum bkod la sogs pa/ /'jug pa sems bskyed thob nas ni/ /phrin las 'ga' zhig bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /cho ga shes na bsgrub par gnang*/ /legs par grub pa yan chad du/ /rang gi dbang bskur ma thob na/ /sems bskyed thob kyang gsang sngags bkag | de yang legs par grub pa las/ /dbang bskur ma byas pa dag la/ /cho ga shes pas sngags mi sby-in/ /zhes sogs rgyas par gsungs la ltos/ /lhag ma rgyud sde gsum po la/ /dbang bskur thob pa ma gtogs pa/ /sems bskyed tsam la brten pa yi/ /yi dam bsgom pa gsungs pa med/ /dbang bskur nang gi rten 'brel yin/ /sems bskyed la ni rten 'brel med/ /des na sems bskyed byas na yang*/ /gsang sngags zab mo bsgom pa la/ /ltung ba yod par rgyal bas gsungs | | de phyir rnam dbye shes dgos so/ /gtor ma'i dbang bskur zhes bya dang*/ /ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang bskur yang*/ /slob ma smin byed cho ga ru/ /rgyud sde kun las gsungs pa med/ /'ga' zhig gsang sngags da lta spyod/ /dbang bskur phyi nas khas len byed/ /'di yang sangs rgyas bstan pa min/ /dbang ma thob la chos bshad na/ /slob dpon ltung ba can 'gyur zhing*/ /slob ma'ang sngon du nyams par 'gyur/ /nyams par gyur pa dam chos kyi/ /snod min zhes ni rgyal bas gsungs

| | mdor na chos kyis ci byed soms/ /sangs rgyas byed na chos bzhin gyis | | la la sems nyid ma rtogs na/ /dbang bskur thob kyang mi phan zer | | gal te sems nyid rtogs gyur na/ /dbang bskur bya yang mi dgos lo/ /'o na sems nyid ma rtogs na/ /sdom pa bsrungs kyang ci zhig phan/ /gal te sems nyid rtogs gyur na/ /sdom pa bsrung yang ci zhig dgos/ /rdo rje phag mo'i byin rlabs kyang*/ /sems nyid rtogs na bya ci dgos// gal te sems nyid ma rtogs na | | byin rlabs byas kyang ci zhig phan/ /de bzhin sems bskyed la sogs pa/ /cho ga kun la tshul 'di mtshungs/ /des na rab byung sdom pa dang*/ /rdo rje phag mo'i byin rlabs dang*/ /sems bskyed 'bad nas byed bzhin du/ /dbang bskur mi dgos zhes smra ba/ /gsang sngags spong ba'i gsang tshig yin/ kha cig cho ga med bzhin du/ /bla ma'i lus kyi dkyil 'khor las/ /dbang bzhi rdzogs par len zhes zer | | 'o na dge tshul dge slong yang*/ /bla ma'i sku las cis mi len/ /sems bskyed kyang ni bla ma yi/ /sku nyid las ni thob pa'i phyir/ /sems bskyed cho ga ci zhig dgos/ /rdo rje phag mo'i byin rlabs kyang*/ /bla ma'i sku las thob pa'i phyir | | chos sgo ba las blang ci dgos/ /de bzhin cho ga thams cad kyang*/ /bla ma'i sku las blangs pas chog /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa yi/ /cho ga zab mo thams cad spongs/ /gal te cho ga nyams gyur na/ /so sor thar dang sems bskyed kyi/ /sdom pa 'chags par mi 'gyur zhing*/ /rdo rje phag mo la sogs pa'i| | byin rlabs 'jug par mi 'gyur na/ /rig 'dzin sngags kyi sdom pa yang*/ /dbang bskur med na thob mi nus/ /des na cho ga gzhan dag la/ /'bad pa chen po byed bzhin du/ /dbang bskur cho ga 'dor byed pa/ /thabs la slu ba'i bdud yod ces/ /gsungs pa 'dir yang dran par bya/ /de phyir dam pa'i don du na | | chos rnams thams cad spros bral yin/

/de la cho ga gang yang med/ /sangs rgyas nyid kyang yod min na/ /cho ga gzhan lta smos ci dgos/ /rgyu dang lam dang 'bras bu yi/ /dbye ba thams cad kun rdzob yin/ /so sor thar dang byang chub sems/ /dbang bskur la sogs cho ga dang*/ /bsgom pa'i dmigs pa ji snyed dang*/ /rten 'brel zab mo thams cad dang*/ /sa dang lam gyi dbye ba dang*/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob pa yang*/ /kun rdzob yin gyi don dam min | | de 'dra'i dbye ba shes nas ni/ /cho ga byed na thams cad gyis/ /min na thams cad dor bar byos/ /cho ga la la dgos bzhin du/ /la la'i cho ga mi dgos zhes/ /smra ba mkhas pa'i bzhad gad gnas/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa'ang dkrugs pa yin/ /bdud kyi byin rlabs zhes bya ba'ang*/ /'di 'dra'i rigs can yin par gsungs/ kha cig bya ba'i rgyud sogs la'ang*/ /dbang bzhi'i cho ga byed pa dang*/ /don yod zhags pa la sogs la'ang*/ /rim gnyis sgom par byed pa thos/ /'di yang sangs rgyas dgongs pa min/ /de yi rgyu mtshan 'di ltar yin/ /bya spyod rnal 'byor rgyud gsum kar/ /dbang bzhi dang ni rim gnyis med | | gal te yod na de dag kyang*/ /rnal 'byor chen po nyid du 'gyur/ /dbang bzhi dang ni rim pa gnyis/ /rnal 'byor chen po'i khyad chos yin/ /grub mtha'i rnam dbye mi phyed cing*/ /rgyud sde'i rim pa mi shes par/ /rnam gzhag legs legs 'dra na yang*/ /lham dpe zhwa la bkab pa yin/ /des na rgyud sde bzhi po yi/ /dbang dang lam gyi dbye ba la/ /mi 'dra'i dbye ba rnam bzhi yod/ /rang rang cho ga bzhin byas na/ /de nas gsungs pa'i dngos grub 'byung*/ /la la dbang bskur ma byas kyang*/ /gal te sngags la mos thob na/ /de nyid chos kyi sgo yin pas | | gsang sngags bsgom du rung zhes zer// 'o na sdom pa ma thob kyang | | rab tu 'byung la mos pa nyid/ /sdom pa len pa'i sgo yin pas/ /sdom pa bsrungs pas chog gam ci/

/sems bskyed sdom pa ma thob kyang*/ /sems bskyed pa la mos pa nyid/ /byang chub spyod pa'i sgo yin pas/ /sems bskyed blang yang ci zhig dgos/ /de bzhin so nam ma byas kyang*/ /lo thog la ni mos pa nyid/ /bza' rgyu za ba'i sgo yin pas/ /so nam la yang 'bad ci dgos/ /'di 'dra'i rigs kyi chos lugs kun/ /de 'dra'i rigs kyis sun dbyung ngo*/ /des na chos sgo zhes bya ba | | 'di yi ming gis 'khrul gzhi byas/ /dbang bskur chos sgo tsam yin gyi | | 'tshang rgya ba yi chos gzhan zhig /bsgom rgyu logs na yod do zhes/ /blun po rnams kyis mun bsgom byas/ /'o na dge slong sdom pa yang*/ /dge slong byed pa'i sgo yin gyi/ /dge slong sdom pa'i ngo bo zhig /gzhan nas btsal du yod dam ci/ /de bzhin so nam byed pa yang*/ /ston thog 'byung ba'i sgo yin gyi/ kha zas 'byung ba'i thabs gzhan zhig /logs nas btsal du yod dam ci/ /des na snying gtam 'di ltar yin/ /dbang bskur chos sgo tsam ma yin/ /gsang sngags rten 'brel lam byed pas/ /rten 'brel bsgrig pa'i gdams ngag yin/ /phung po khams dang skye mched la/ /sangs rgyas sa bon btab nas ni/ /tshe 'dir sangs rgyas byed pa yi/ /thabs la dbang bskur zhes su btags/ /des na gang zag dbang po rab/ /dbang bskur nyid kyis grol bar gsungs/ /dbang gis grol bar ma nus pa'i/ /gang zag gzhan la bsgom dgos so/ /des na dbang bskur thob pa de/ /bsrung zhing 'phel bar byed pa la/ /bsgom pa zhes su btags pa yin/ /de phyir pha rol phyin pa la/ /sems bskyed min pa'i chos gzhan med | | rdo rje theg pa'i sgor zhugs nas/ /dbang bskur las gzhan chos med do/ /des na thub pas rgyud sde las/ /dbang bskur kho nar bsngags pa dang*/ /mkhas rnams ci nas dbang bskur la/ /gus pa'i rgyu mtshan de ltar yin/ /la la dbang bskur mu bzhi 'dod/ /dbang bskur byas kyang ma thob dang*/

/ma byas kyang ni thob pa dang*/ /byas na thob la ma byas na/ /mi thob pa dang rnam bzhir 'dod/ /'di 'dra gang na'ang bshad pa med/ /bstan pa dkrugs pa'i snyad kar zad/ /'on kyang 'di yang brtag par bya/ /so sor thar pa'i sdom pa dang*/ /byang chub sems dpa'i sems bskyed la'ang*/ /mu bzhi ci yi phyir mi brtsi | | de bzhin bsgom la'ang cis mi mtshungs/ /bsgoms kyang mi skye ma bsgoms kyang | | skye ba la sogs mu bzhi yod/ /mu bzhi kun la yod bzhin du/ /gzhan la mu bzhi mi brtsi bar/ /dbang bskur nyid la brtsi ba ni/ /bdud kyi gsang tshig yin par dogs/ /gal te mu bzhi yod na yang*/ /so so'i mtshan nyid shes mi nus | | ci ste shes par nus na ni/ /de yi mtshan nyid smra dgos so/ /smras kyang rang bzo ma yin pa/ /lung dang mthun pa khyed la med/ / gal te mu bzhi bden srid na | | gzhan la dbang bskur mi byed kyang*/ /byas na thob pa'i gang zag la/ /dbang bskur ci yi phyir mi dgos/ /gzhan la dbang bskur mi dgos pas/ /de la'ang dbang bskur mi dgos na/ /nad med pa la sman spong bas/ /nad pa la yang spong ngam ci/ /'di 'dra'i chos log thams cad ni/ /bdud kyi byin rlabs yin zhes bya | kha cig gsang sngags gsang ba la/ /ye gsang thabs kyis chod pa'i phyir | | gsang sgrog ltung ba med ces zer/ /'di yang cung zad brtag par bya/ /ye gsang zhes bya'i don ci zhig /gal te go ba med pa la/ /zer na go ba'i gang zag la | | ye gsang min phyir ltung bar 'gyur/ /gal te dam pa'i chos yin pas | | dam chos bden pa'i byin rlabs 'di/ /su yis thos kyang phan yon che | | des na gsang sgrogs mi 'byung na/ /gal te dam chos bden pa ru//go na chos nas 'byung bzhin gyis/ /chos la gsang dang mi gsang ba'i/ /lugs gnyis rgyal ba rnams kyis gsungs/ /des na ye gsang zhes bya ba/ /'di yang bstan la gnod tshig yin/ kha cig 'khrul dang ma 'khrul med/ /thabs lam gcig tu nges pa med

| | lta ba rtogs pas klu sgrub grol/ /pad+ma 'byung gnas bskyed rim gyis | | dka' thub spyad pas lū hi pa/ /spyod pa'i grogs kyis nag po pa/ /rlung gi stobs kyis go rak+ṣa/ /gtum mo'i stobs kyis sha wa ri/ /phyag rgya chen pos sa ra ha | | byin rlabs stobs kyis tog tse ba/ /za nyal 'chag gis zhi ba lha/ /in+d+ra bhū ti 'dod yon gyis/ /rten 'brel thams cad tshogs pa las/ /bir+wa pa la grub thob byung | | 'di 'dra'i thabs lam sna tshogs la/ /skur ba gdab tu mi rung zer | | 'di yang legs par bshad kyis nyon/ /thabs dang shes rab gnyis min pa'i | | sangs rgyas sgrub pa'i thabs gzhan med/ /des na grub thob thams cad kyang | | phyogs re'i thabs kyis grol ba min/ /dbang dang rim gnyis las byung ba'i| | ye shes skyes pas grol ba yin/ /lta ba dang ni bskyed rim dang*/ /gtum mo dang ni byin rlabs sogs/ /de dag rkyang pas grol ba min/ /dbang bskur ba yi byin rlabs dang*/ /rim gnyis bsgoms pa'i rten 'brel gyis/ /ye shes rtogs nas grol ba yin/ /bskyed rim rlung dang gtum mo sogs/ /rim pa gnyis las tha dad min/ /byin rlabs de las byung ba yin/ /lta ba de yi yan lag yin/ /phyag rgya chen po de'i ye shes/ /de yi spros bcas spyod pa ni/ /in+d+ra bhu tis mdzad pa yin//de yi spros med spyod pa la//bhu su ku zhes sangs rgyas gsungs/ /de yi shin tu spraus med ni/ /rim gnyis brtan par bya ba'i phyir/ /grub thob rnams kyis mdzad pa ni/ /kun tu bzang po'i spyod par bshad/ /des na rgyu rkyen ma tshogs par | | sangs rgyas 'bras bu mi 'byung mod/ /snga ma'i las 'phro'i bye brag dang*/ /nang gi rten 'brel khyad par gyis/ /ye shes skye ba'i sna 'dren ni | | thabs kyi dbye bas byed par gsungs/ /dper na nad pa'i lus brtas pa | | bza' dang btung bas byed mod kyi/ /de yi yi ga 'byed pa ni/

/zas kyi khyad par yin pa bzhin/ /de phyir thabs kyi khyad par la/ /skur ba 'debs na blun po yin/ /'on kyang re res 'tshang rgya bar/ /'dod na shin tu 'khrul par bshad | | des na smin byed dbang dang ni/ /rim pa gnyis la 'bad par gyis/ /so nam tshul bzhin byas pa yis/ /lo tog rim gyis smin pa ltar/ /pha rol phyin pa'i lam zhugs na/ /grangs med gsum gyis rdzogs 'tshang rgya/ /sngags kyis btab pa'i sa bon ni/ /nyi ma gcig la lo tog smin/ /rdo rje theg pa'i thabs shes na | | tshe 'di nyid la sangs rgyas 'grub/ /stong nyid snying rje sogs bsgom pa/ /pha rol phyin pa'i gzhung lugs yin/ /de yis ji ltar myur na yang*/ /grangs med gsum gyi dka' spyad dgos/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas lam po che/ /rtsod pa kun las grol ba'i chos/ /mkhas pa kun gyis gus pas bsten/ /gal te 'di bzhin bsgrub 'dod na/ /rdo rje phag mo'i byin rlabs med/ /lhan skyes la sogs 'dir mi bsgom | | gtum mo la sogs thabs lam bral/ /phyag rgya chen po'i tha snyad med | | tshe 'di dang ni bar do dang*/ /phyi mar 'tshang rgya khong mi bzhed/ /'on kyang theg pa chen po yi/ /sde snod rnams las 'byung ba bzhin/ /byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed la/ /grangs med gsum du tshogs gnyis sogs/ /sems can yongs su smin pa dang*/ /sangs rgyas zhing rnams legs par sbyongs/ /sa bcu'i tha mar bdud btul nas/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par gsungs/ /pha rol phyin gzhung mi nus par/ /gal te gsang sngags bsgom 'dod na/ /nor ba med pa'i dbang bzhi long*/ /'khrul pa med pa'i rim gnyis sgoms/ /de las byung ba'i ye shes ni/ /phyag rgya chen po goms par bya/ /de nas 'khor 'das bsre ba'i phyir | | rnam par dag pa'i spyod pa spyad/ /nang gi sa lam kun bgrod nas/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa dge ba/ /bcu gsum pa ni thob par 'gyur/ /'di ni dus gsum sangs rgyas kyi/

/dam pa'i chos kyi snying po yin/ /rgyud sde rnams kyi gsang tshig mchog /'di nyid yin par shes par bya/ /gang zhig sangs rgyas byed 'dod na | | de yis 'di bzhin spyad par bya/ /yang na pha rol phyin pa yi/ /mdo las ji ltar 'byung bzhin gyis/ /yang na rdo rje theg pa yi/ /rgyud sde bzhin du nyams su long | | 'di gnyis min pa'i theg chen ni/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyis gsungs pa med | | da lta'i chos pa phal che ba/ /bslab pa gsum po mi sbyong bas/ /pha rol phyin pa'i chos lugs min/ /dbang dang rim gnyis mi ldan pas/ /rdo rje theg pa'i bstan pa min/ /'dul ba'i sde snod mi shes pas/ /nyan thos kyi yang chos lugs min | | 'on kyang chos par khas 'che ba/ /kye ma gang gi bstan pa 'gyur/ /pha med pa yi bu mang yang*/ /rigs kyi nang du chud mi nus/ /de bzhin khungs nas ma byung ba'i | | chos pa bstan pa'i nang du min/ /dag dug bsdus pa'i gos la ni/ /chen po rnams kyi chas mi rung*/ /de bzhin thun tshags bsdus pa yi/ /chos kyis dad can 'tshang mi rgya/ /mu stegs byed pa kha cig kyang*/ /sangs rgyas pa la 'di skad zer | | sdig pa spong zhing dge byed na/ /mu stegs yin yang ci zhig skyon/ /dge ba med cing sdig byed na/ /chos pa yin yang ci phan lo/ /de bzhin 'di na'ang blun po 'ga'/ /dad dang ldan zhing snying rje che/ /sbyin dang tshul khrims bzod pa bsgom// bsam gtan bsgom zhing stong pa nyid/ /rtogs na sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa'i | | mdo rgyud rnams dang mi mthun yang*/ /de la skyon med de med na/ /mdo rgyud mthun yang ci phan lo/ /de yang brtag par bya bas nyon/ /mu stegs byed la sdom pa med | | de phyir dge ba byas na yang*/ /bar ma yin gyi sdom pa las/ /byung ba'i dge ba srid ma yin/ /de bzhin dbang bskur ma thob pa/ /de la rig 'dzin sdom pa med | | sdom med de yis dge spyad kyang*/ /bar ma yin gyi gsang sngags kyi/

/sdom pa las byung dge ba min/ /sdom pa'i dge ba ma yin na/ /gsang sngags thabs lam rab zab kyang*/ /'tshang mi rgya bar thub pas gsungs/ /sdom pa gsum dang ldan pa yi/ /rim gnyis zab mo'i gnad shes na/ /de ni tshe 'di'am bar do'am/ /skye ba bcu drug tshun chad na/ /'grub par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gsungs/ /de phyir 'di la mkhas rnams gus/ /gang dag rab tu 'byung 'dod na/ /sdom pa bsrung phyir gus pas long*/ /lto gos tsam la dmigs pa yi/ /rab tu 'byung ba thub pas bkag | sems bskyed byed pa de dag kyang*/ /bstan pa'i lugs bzhin mi byed kyi | | thos chung rnams kyis mgo bskor nas/ /blun po dga' bar bya phyir yin/ / gsang sngags bsgom pa mang mod kyi/ /rgyud sde bzhin du bsgrub pa nyung*/ /spyod pa bde ba'i 'du shes kyis/ /rang bzor gsang sngags spyod par zad/ /gal te dbang bskur byed na yang*/ /bzang po'i gzhung lugs kun dor nas/ /gang dag brdzun gyis bslad pa la/ /ngo mtshar bzhin du gus pas len/ /brgya la bskyed rim bsgom na yang*/ /sbyang gzhi sbyong byed legs 'phrod pa'i/ /cho ga'i yan lag kun bor nas

| | rang bzo'i dkrongs bskyed bsgom par zad/ /gtum mo bsgom pa phal cher yang*/ /nang gi rten 'brel mi shes par/ /mu stegs byed kyi gtum mo ltar | | drod tsam la ni dmigs par go /ye shes cung zad skyes na yang*/ /de dag nyon mongs rnam rtog dang*/ /'byed pa'i thabs la mi mkhas pas/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas lam mi 'gyur/ /bla ma la ni mos na yang*/ /de 'dra'i bla ma bla ma min | | dpon slob gnyi ga gsang sngags kyi/ /sdom pa med pa yin phyir ro/ /dper na rab byung ma byas na/ /mkhan po'i tha snyad med pa bzhin/ /de bzhin dbang bskur ma thob na/ /bla ma'i tha snyad mi 'byung ngo*/ /gsang sngags min pa'i bla ma la/ /mos pa byas kyang tshe 'di yi/ /bde skyid phun tshogs tsam zhig gam/ /rim gyis 'grub pa'i rgyu srid kyi/ /de ni tshe 'di'am bar do la/ /sangs rgyas nyid sbyin mi nus so/ /pha rol phyin pa'i gzhung lugs las/ /bla ma sangs rgyas lta bu ru/ /blta bar bya zhes gsungs mod kyi/ /sangs rgyas dngos su gsungs pa med/ /bla ma sangs rgyas nyid yin zhes/ /bya ba dbang bskur thob nas yin/ /dbang bskur sdom pas ma 'brel na/ /bzang yang pha rol phyin pa yin/ /rab byung min la mkhan po med/ /dbang ma bskur la bla ma med/ /sdom pa med la dge rgyun med/ /skyabs 'gro med na chos pa min/ /dge sbyong sdom pa med pa dang*/ /rgyal sras sems bskyed ma thob pa/ /sngags pa dbang bskur med pa gsum/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa'i chom rkun yin/ /phyag rgya chen po bsgom na yang*/ /rtog pa kha 'tshom nyid bsgom gyi | | rim gnyis las byung ye shes la/ /phyag rgya chen por mi shes so/ / blun po phyag rgya che bsgom pa/ /phal cher dud 'gro'i rgyu ru gsungs/ /min na gzugs med khams su skye/ /yang na nyan thos 'gog par ltung*/ /gal te de ni bsgom legs kyang | | dbu ma'i bsgom las lhag pa med/ /dbu ma'i bsgom de bzang mod kyi

| | 'on kyang 'grub pa shin tu dka'/ /ji srid tshogs gnyis ma rdzogs pa/ /de srid bsgom de mthar mi phyin/ /'di yi tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa la/ /bskal pa grangs med dgos par gsungs/ /nged kyi phyag rgya chen po ni/ /dbang las byung ba'i ye shes dang*/ /rim pa gnyis kyi ting 'dzin las/ /byung ba'i rang byung ye shes yin/ /'di yi rtogs pa gsang sngags kyi/ /thabs la mkhas na tshe 'dir 'grub/ /de las gzhan du phyag rgya che/ /rtogs pa sangs rgyas kyis ma gsungs | | des na phyag rgya chen po la/ /mos na gsang sngags gzhung bzhin sgrubs | | da lta'i phyag rgya chen po dang*/ /rgya nag lugs kyi rdzogs chen la | | yas 'bab dang ni mas 'dzegs gnyis/ /rim gyis pa dang cig char bar | | ming 'dogs bsgyur ba ma gtogs pa/ /don la khyad par dbye ba med/ / chos lugs 'di 'dra 'byung ba yang*/ /byang chub sems dpa' zhi ba 'tshos/ /rgyal po khri srong ldai btsan la/ /lung bstan ji bzhin thog tu bab/ /lung bstan de yang bshad kyis nyon/ /rgyal po khyod kyi bod yul 'dir/ /slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis | | brtan ma bcu gnyis la gtad pas/ /mu stegs 'byung bar mi 'gyur mod | | 'on kyang rten 'brel 'ga' yi rgyus/ /chos lugs gnyis su 'gro bar 'gyur/ /de yang thog mar nga 'das nas/ /rgya nag dge slong byung nas ni | | dkar po chig thub ces bya ba/ /cig char ba yi lam ston 'gyur/ /de tshe nga yi slob ma ni/ /mkhas pa chen po ka ma la/ /shī la zhes bya rgya gar nas/ /spyan drongs de yis de sun 'byin/ /de nas de yi chos lugs bzhin/ /dad ldan rnams kyis spyod cig gsung*/ /de yis ji skad gsungs pa bzhin/ /phyi nas thams cad bden par gyur/ /rgya nag lugs de nub mdzad nas/ /rim gyis pa yi chos lugs spel | | phyi nas rgyal khrims nub pa dang*/ /rgya nag mkhan po'i gzhung lugs kyi | | yi ge tsam la brten nas kyang*/ /de yi ming 'dogs gsang nas ni/

/phyag rgya chen por ming bsgyur nas/ /da lta'i phyag rgya chen po ni/ /phal cher rgya nag chos lugs yin/ /nā ro dang ni mai tṝ+i ba'i/ /phyag rgya chen po gang yin pa/ /de ni las dang chos dang ni/ /dam tshig dang ni phyag rgya che/ /gsang sngags rgyud nas ji skad du/ /gsungs pa de nyid khong bzhed do/ /'phags pa klu sgrub nyid kyis kyang | | phyag rgya bzhi par 'di skad gsungs/ /las kyi phyag rgya mi shes pas/ /chos kyi phyag rgya'ang mi shes na/ /phyag rgya chen po'i ming tsam yang*/ / rtogs pa nyid ni mi srid gsung*/ /rgyud kyi rgyal po gzhan dang ni/ /bstan bcos chen po gzhan las kyang | | dbang bskur dag dang ma 'brel ba/ /de la phyag rgya chen po bkag /dbang bskur ba las byung ba yi/ /ye shes phyag rgya che rtogs na/ /da gzod mtshan ma dang bcas pa'-i/ /'bad rtsol kun la mi ltos so/ /deng sang 'ga' zhig bla ma yi/ / mos gus tsam gyis sems bsgyur nas/ /rtog pa cung zad 'gags pa la/ /phyag rgya chen po'i ngo sprod byed/ /de 'dra bdud kyi yin pa'ang srid/ /yang na khams 'dus 'ga' la'ang 'byung*/ /ka ru 'dzin zhes bya ba yi/ /brdzun rlabs can gyi grub thob byung | | de yi dgon pa mthong tsam gyis/ /'ga' la ting 'dzin skyes zhes zer/ /phyi nas de yi grub thob zhig /de nas ting 'dzin de rgyun chad/ /de 'dra'i ting 'dzin bdud rigs kyi/ /'byung po rnams kyis byed par gsungs/ /sangs rgyas gsung bzhin bsgrub pa yi/ /byin rlabs sangs rgyas rnams kyi yin/ kha cig skye ba snga ma la | | sems bskyed dbang bskur ma byas na/ /chos la dad pa mi srid pas/ /gang dag theg chen dad thob pa/ /de dag sngar sbyangs yin pas na/ /da lta dbang bskur mi dgos zer/ /'o na so sor thar pa yi/ /sdom pa dag la mos pa yang*/ /snga ma'i sdom pa yod pa'i phyir//da lta rab tu dbyung ci dgos//byang chub sems dpa'i sems bskyed kyang*/

/snga ma'i sems bskyed yod pa'i phyir/ /da lta sems bskyed bya ci dgos/ /de dag dgos na gsang sngags kyi/ /dbang bskur yang ni cis mi dgos/ /sangs rgyas chos la mi dga' ba'i/ /mu stegs byed kyi chos spangs pa | | de la mtshar du mi brtsi yi/ /sangs rgyas chos la brten bzhin du/ /mdo rgyud nyan bshad 'gog byed pa/ /de la kho bo ngo mtshar skyes/ /la la zhi gnas cung zad dang*/ /snang stong rtogs pa phra mo la/ /mthong lam yin zhes ngo sprod byed/ khyung gi sgong rgya ji bzhin du/ /lus kyi rgya yis bcings pas na/ /da lta yon tan mi 'byung bas | | lus rgya zhig pa'i shi ma thag /yon tan phyi nas 'byung zhes zer/ /theg pa chen po'i mdo rgyud las/ /'di 'dra'i chos lugs bshad pa med/ /nyi ma de ring shar ba yi/ /'od zer nangs par 'byung ba mtshar/ kha cig pha rol phyin pa dang*/ / gsang sngags gnyis kyi mthong lam la/ /rgyan can rgyan med yin zhes zer/ /de lta yin na sangs rgyas kyang*/ /rgyan can rgyan med gnyis su 'gyur/ /nyan thos rnams kyi dgra bcom la/ /rgyan can rgyan med gnyis 'thad kyi/ /theg pa chen po'i 'phags pa la/ /rgyan can rgyan med gnyis mi srid/ /nyan thos lcags kyi tsha tsha'i dpes/ /tshe 'dir mya ngan ma 'das pa/ /bar dor mya ngan 'da' bar gsungs | | de bzhin gsang sngags bsgom pa las/ /tshe 'dir mthong lam ma thob pa | | bar dor mthong lam thob mod kyi/ /tshe 'dir mthong lam skyes pa la/ /yon tan shi nas 'byung ba ni/ /blun po rnams kyi brdzun rib yin/ /mdo rgyud kun dang mi mthun pas/ /'di 'dra'i chos lugs mkhas pas spangs/ /jo bo nā ro ta pa ni | | dbang bskur dus su mthong lam skye/ /de ni skad cig de la 'gag / chos mchog rjes kyi mthong lam ni/ /'gag pa med ces gsungs par grag /'di ni dpe yi ye shes la/ /mthong ba'i lam du btags par zad/ /'phags pa lha yis spyod bsdus su/ /bden pa mthong yang las mtha' la/

/chags par gsungs pa rdzogs rim gyi/ /rang byung ye shes rtogs pa ni/ /dpe yi ye shes nyid la dgongs/ /de dang lam 'bras la sogs pa/ /grub thob rnams kyi dgongs pa mthun | | des na nged kyi mthong lam ni/ /'phags pa min la 'byung mi srid/ /theg pa gsum gyi lag len yang*/ /rang rang gzhung lugs bzhin byed na/ /sangs rgyas bstan yin mi byed na/ /bstan pa'i gzugs brnyan yin zhes bya/ /nyan thos rnams kyi bla ma de/ /bzang yang gang zag kho nar bas/ /pha rol phyin pa'i bla ma ni/ /bzang na dge 'dun dkon mchog yin/ /gsang sngags pa yi bla ma mchog /dkon mchog gsum dang dbyer med yin/ /des na de la gsol btab pas/ /dkon mchog gsum po tshe 'dir 'grub/ /de lta'i theg pa gsum po yi//so so'i gzhung nas 'byung ba bzhin/ /bla ma'i mtshan nyid mi ldan na/ /bla ma yin gyi dam pa min/ /de la gsol ba btab na yang*/ /byin rlabs cung zad 'byung mod kyi/ /tshe 'di'am bar do la sogs su/ /sangs rgyas nyid sbyin mi nus so/ /des na dbang bskur thob pa'i mis | | dkon mchog gsum po bla ma ru/ /'dus par mthong nas bla ma la/ / gsol ba btab na byin rlabs 'jug /gal te dbang bskur ma thob na/ /bla ma dkon mchog gsum nyid du/ /phar la bsdus la gsol ba thob/ /rim gyis byin rlabs ci rigs 'jug /bla ma rkyang pa bzang srid kyang*/ /gsol ba btab pa byin rlabs chung*/ /de bas dkon mchog gsum nyid la/ /gsol ba btab pa shin tu bzang | | dbang bskur dang po ma thob par/ /bskyed pa'i rim pa bsgom pa dang*/ /dbang bskur gnyis pa ma thob par/ /gtum mo la sogs bsgom pa dang*/ /dbang bskur gsum pa ma thob par/ /bde stong la sogs bsgom pa dang*/ /dbang bskur bzhi pa ma thob par/ /phyag rgya chen po sogs bsgom dang*/ /dge slong sdom pa ma thob par/ /mkhan slob la sogs byed pa ni/ /gsang sngags med par sbrul gdug gi /mgo las rin chen len pa ltar/

/rang gzhan brlag pa'i rgyu ru bas | | mkhas pa rnams kyis rgyang ring spang*/ /gzhan yang gangs ri'i khrod 'di na | | 'khrul pa'i lag len du ma yod/ kha 'bar ma yi gtor ma la/ /de bzhin gshegs pa bzhi yi mtshan/ /sngon la brjod pa'i lag len mthong*/ /'di yang mdo dang mthun ma yin/ /mdo las sngon la sngags brjod nas/ /sangs rgyas bzhi po phyi nas gsungs/ /'ga' zhig chu sbyin nang du zan/ /'jug pa'i lag len byed pa thos/ /'jur gegs can kyi yi dwags kyis/ /chu sbyin nang du zan mthong na/ /'jigs pa chen po 'byung bar gsungs/ /des na chu sbyin nang du zan | | 'degs pa cho ga nyams pa yin/ /zan gyi phud la lha bshos dang*/ /chang bu bya bar sangs rgyas gsungs/ /rdo rje rtse mo'i rgyud las ni/ /zas kyi phud la chang bu sbyin/ /zhes gsungs 'phrog ma'i mdo las kyang*/ /sangs rgyas ston par khas 'che na/ /'phrog ma la ni chang bu sby-in/ /zhes gsungs de yi cho ga ni/ /lta ba ngan sel la sogs ltos/ /'ga' zhig sangs rgyas gsungs pa yi/ /lha bshos chang bu mi byed par/ /ma gsungs pa yi 'brang rgyas dang*/ /gru gsum la sogs byed pa mthong | | gsang sngags rnying ma 'ga' zhig las/ /gru gsum dbang phyug chen po'i snying | | de yi sha dang khrag gis brgyan/ /mtheb kyu mgo bo'i thod pas bskor | | chang sogs bdud rtsis de bkang nas/ /he ru ka la mchod ces zer | | gsang sngags gsar mar gru gsum gyi/ /gtor ma gzhung nas bshad pa med | | zas kyi phud la khyad par du/ /gru gsum 'bul ba gsungs pa med/ /lag len thams cad sangs rgyas kyi/ /gsung dang mthun na bstan pa yin/ /des na mdo sde ma dkrug par/ /sangs rgyas gsung bzhin nyams su long*/ /sangs rgyas rab tu byung ba yi/ /phyag tu mtshon cha bskur ba mthong*/ khyim pa'i cha lugs can dag la | | rgyan dang mtshon cha sogs srid kyi/ /rab byung rnams la 'di mi srid/ /byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya sogs/

/mdzad pa'i rigs lnga ser 'byam mthong*/ /mdo lugs yin zhes la la smra/ /mdo nas 'di 'dra gsungs pa med/ /bya spyaud gnyis kyi rgyud las kyang*/ /sangs rgyas rigs lngar bsdus pa med/ /rnal 'byor rgyud las gsungs pa yi/ /rigs lnga kha dog tha dad cing*/ /phyag rgya yang ni tha dad gsungs/ /'di yi sku mdog phyag rgya ni/ /rten cing 'brel 'byung sku yin pas/ /ye shes lnga la 'thad pa yin/ /dus kyi 'khor lo la sogs las/ /rigs lnga'i kha dog gzhan gsungs pa/ /'byung ba rnam pa lnga sbyong ba'i/ /rten cing 'brel 'byung sku yin no | | sangs rgyas gser mdog ces gsungs pa/ /dri ma med cing dwangs pa yang*/ /sprul sku phal la dgongs te gsungs/ /gzhan du sman bla nam mkha'i mdog | sngon po nyid du mdo las gsungs/ /yi dam lha yi sgrub thabs dang*/ / sngags kyi bzlas pa'i cho ga dang*/ / mchog dang thun mong dngos grub dang*/ /sgrub pa'i cho ga ji snyed pa/ /mdo sde kun las gsungs pa med/ /deng sang sngags la mi mos par/ /lha bsgom la sogs byed pa yang*/ /sangs rgyas bstan dang mthun pa min | | gzhan yang sbyin sreg ro sreg dang*/ /bdun tshigs sāts+tsha'i cho ga sogs/ / deng sang gsang sngags lugs bor nas/ /mdo mchod tsam la brten pa yi/ /cho ga'i rnam gzhag byed pa yod/ /pha rol phyin pa'i mdo sde dang*/ /bstan bcos kun las gsungs pa med/ /'di dag ngan song sbyong rgyud la/ /sogs pa'i rgyud sde 'ga' zhig las/ /gsungs pa'i rjes su 'brang ba yi/ /gsang sngags pa la grags pa yin/ /de bzhin rab gnas mdo lugs dang*/ /phyag na rdo rje mdo lugs dang*/ /ltung bshags dang ni sher snying sogs/ /sngags lugs yin zhes 'chad pa thos/ /'di yang brtag par bya bas nyon/ /mdo nas rab gnas bshad pa med/ /'on kyang mchod bstod bkra shis sogs/ /rgyal po'i mnga' dbul lta bu la/ /rab gnas yin zhes smra na smraus/ /lha bsgom pa dang sngags bzlas dang*//
