bum pa lha yi sta gon dang*/ /dngos gzhi'i dam tshig sems dpa' dang*/ /ye shes 'khor lo dgug gzhug dang*/ /spyan dbye brtan par bzhugs pa dang*/ /sngags kyis byin gyis brlabs pa yi/ /me tog dor nas legs mchod de/ /bkra shis rgyas par byed pa yi/ /cho ga gsang sngags rgyud sde las/ /gsungs kyi pha rol phyin las min | | la la gdams ngag yin zhes smra/ /'o na mdo sde gang dag la/ /brten pa yin pa smra dgos so/ /deng sang gsang ba 'dus pa'i lha/ /bsgoms nas mdo lugs yin zhes smra/ /gsang 'dus la sogs cho ga la/ /mdo lugs cho ga 'byung ba mtshar/ /seng ge'i phru gu glang chen las/ /byung na sngon med srog chags yin/ / mkhas pa rnams kyis 'di 'dra yi/ /cho ga slan chad ma byed cig /lha la rab tu gnas pa dang*/ /mi la dbang bskur bya ba sogs/ /rdo rje slob ma'i dbang bskur ba | | thob kyang bya bar ma gsungs na/ /dbang bskur gtan nas ma thob pa'i/ /gang zag rnams kyis smos ci dgos/ /rdo rje slob ma'i dbang bskur tsam/ /thob nas lha bsgom tsam dang ni/ /bzlas brjod dang ni sbyin sreg dang*/ /las tshogs la sogs bsgrub pa yi/ /dngos grub dang ni phyag rgya yi/ /ye shes sgrub pa'i cho ga dang*/ /gsang sngags 'ga' zhig nyan pa la/ /dbang ba yin gyi rgyud 'chad dang

| | dbang bskur dang ni rab gnas sogs/ /slob dpon phrin las byar mi rung | | rdo rje slob dpon dbang thob nas/ /'khor lo lha yi de nyid sogs/ / rnam dag dkyil 'khor bsgom pa dang*/ /dbang bskur dang ni rab gnas sogs/ / slob dpon gyi ni phrin las dang*/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi dam tshig dang*/ /bla na med pa'i sdom pa sogs/ /rdo rje slob dpon kho na'i las/ /nyid yin gzhan gyis byar mi rung | | deng sang rab gnas mdo lugs zhes/ /'chad pa sangs rgyas bstan pa min/ khyim pas mkhan slob byed pa dang*/ /rdo rje slob dpon ma yin pas/ /dbang bskur rab gnas byed pa ni/ /gnyis ka bstan pa min par mtshungs/ /phyag na rdo rje'i bsgom bzlas kyang*/ /mdo sde rnams nas bshad pa med/ /gzungs nas bshad pa de dag ni/ /bya ba'i rgyud kyi cho ga yin/ /ltung bshags sangs rgyas phyag mtshan la | | phub dang ral gri sogs 'dzin pa'i/ /sgrub thabs sangs rgyas kyis ma gsungs | | mdo dang rgyud kyi khyad par ni/ /cho ga'i bya ba yod med yin/ /de ltar shes nas mdo sde dang*/ /sngags kyi lugs rnams dpyod de smros/ /la la theg pa rim dgu la/ /lta ba tha dad yod ces zer/ /nyan thos dang ni theg chen la/ /lta ba'i rim pa yod mod kyi/ /pha rol phyin dang gsang sngags la/ /lta ba'i dbye ba bshad pa med/ /pha rol phyin pa'i spros bral las/ /lhag pa'i lta ba yod na ni/ /lta de spros pa can du 'gyur/ /spros bral yin na khyad par med/ /des na bshad pas go ba yi/ /thos pa'i lta ba gcig nyid yin/ /'on kyang spros bral rtogs pa yi/ / thabs la gsang sngags khyad par 'phags/ kha cig dbu ma'i lta ba ni/ /kun rdzob ji ltar snang bzhin yin/ /don dam mtha' bzhi'i spros dang bral/ /bya ba'i rgyud kyi kun rdzob ni/ /rigs gsum rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor yin/ /don dam dbu ma dang mtshungs zer/ /spyod pa'i rgyud kyi kun rdzob dang*/ /rnal 'byor rgyud kyi kun rdzob ni/

/rigs lnga'i rgyal bar snang ba yin/ /rnal 'byor chen po'i kun rdzob ni || dam pa rigs brgya yin zhes zer/ /lta bsgom rnam dbye ma phyed cing*/ /thabs dang shes rab ma shes pas/ /'di 'dra'i dbye ba 'khrul pa yin/ /'di yi 'thad pa bshad kyis nyon/ /rigs gsum la sogs sangs rgyas su/ /bsgom pa yin gyi lta ba min/ /bya spyod rnal 'byor rgyud gsum las/ /snang ba lha ru gsungs pa med | | 'on kyang bya ba'i rgyud du ni/ /bris sku lha ru bsgoms nas kyang*/ /de las dngos grub len pa yin/ /des na dka' thub gtsang sbra yis/ /sangs rgyas mnyes nas dngos grub gnang*/ /spyod pa'i rgyud du bris sku dang*/ /rang nyid gnyis ka lhar bsgoms nas/ /grogs po lta bu'i dngos grub len/ /rnal 'byor rgyud du phyi rol la/ /dmigs pa'i rkyen tsam byas nas kyang*/ /rang nyid dam tshig sems dpa' la/ /ye shes 'khor lo spyan drangs nas/ /ji srid phyag rgya ma bkrol ba/ /de yi bar du sangs rgyas bzhugs/ /phyag rgya bkrol nas sangs rgyas gshegs/ /de nas rang nyid tha mal 'gyur/ /'di dag gi ni lung sbyor rnams/ /yi ge mangs kyis dogs pas bzhag /rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud du ni/ /dag pa gsum gyi rang bzhin bshad/ /'di yi lung rigs man ngag rnams/ /bla ma'i zhal las legs par dris/ /gal te bya ba'i rgyud kyi yang*/ /kun rdzob lha ru gnas na ni | | dka' thub gtsang sbra ga la 'thad/ /lha la gtsang dang mi gtsang med/ /lha rnams dka' thub kyis mi gdung*/ kha cig spyod pa'i rgyud kyi yang*/ /lta ba rnal 'byor rgyud dang mthun/ /spyod pa bya ba'i rgyud bzhin byed/ /'di yang de ltar nges pa med/ /'di ni gnyis ka'i rgyud yin pas/ /res 'ga' gtsang sbra spyod mod kyi | | phal cher ci bder spyod par gsungs/ /spyod pa'i rgyud la rigs lnga yi/ /don grub na yang tha snyad med/ /phyag rgya sku mdog rnam dag kyang*/

/rnal 'byor rgyud bzhin der ma gsungs/ /des na rnal 'byor rgyud man chad/ /kun rdzob lha ru gsungs pa med/ /'on kyang kun rdzob thams cad ni/ /ji ltar snang ba bzhin du bas | | bris sku la sogs lhar bsgom pa/ /de ni thabs kyi khyad par yin/ /rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud sde las/ /kun rdzob ji ltar snang ba 'di/ /thabs la mkhas pa'i khyad par gyis/ /sbyang gzhi sbyong byed ngo sprod pa/ /de tshe dam pa rigs brgya la | | sogs pa'i dbye ba rgyal bas gsungs/ /des na kun rdzob ldog pa dang*/ / lha yi ldog pa ma phyed pas/ /gsang sngags rnying ma'i kun rdzob kun/ /lta ba dang 'khrul de ltar yin/ /gsang sngags snga 'gyur pa rnams ni/ /rnal 'byor rnal 'byor chen po dang*/ /rjes su rnal 'byor shin tu ni/ /rnal 'byor zhes bya rnam pa bzhi/ /theg pa'i rim pa yin zhes zer/ /shin tu rnal 'byor bzang bar 'dod/ / gsang sngags phyi 'gyur ba rnams ni/ /rnal 'byor rjes su rnal 'byor dang*/ /shin tu rnal 'byor rnal 'byor che/ /'di dag ting 'dzin rim yin gyi/ /rgyud sde'i rim par mi bzhed do/ /des na rgyud sde bzhi po yi/ /rnal 'byor rnal 'byor chen po dang*/ /rnal 'byor bzhi yi rnal 'byor dang*/ /rnal 'byor chen po mi gcig go | dper na klu chen pad+ma dang*/ /pad+ma chen po zhes bya dang*/ /me tog pad+ma pad chen gnyis | | ming mthun na yang don mi gcig /des na gsang sngags gsar ma la | | rnal 'byor chen po'i ltag na ni/ /de bas lhag pa'i rgyud sde med/ /bsgom pa'i dmigs pa nyid kyang ni/ /rnal 'byor chen po'i gong na med/ /de las skyes pa'i ye shes ni/ /spros pa med cing brjod bral bas/ /theg pa'i rim par mi bzhed do/ /lugs 'di legs par shes gyur na/ /a ti yo ga'i lta ba yang*/ /ye shes yin gyi theg pa min/ /brjod bral brjod byar byas pa ni/ /mkhas pa'i dgongs pa min zhes bya/

/des na thos pa'i lta ba ni/ /dbu ma yan chad thams cad mthun | | de phyir lta ba'i lung sbyor kun/ /pha rol phyin bzhin thams cad mdzad/ /de rtogs pa yi thabs la ni/ /theg pa'i rim pa yod pa yin/ /rgyud sde bzhi yi bsgrub pa yang*/ /'khrul par byas na dngos grub ring*/ /bya ba'i rgyud la bdag bskyed med/ /bris sku mchod nas gsol ba 'debs/ /bdag bskyed sgrub thabs yod pa ni/ /rnal 'byor rgyud kyi rjes 'brangs nas/ /de yi lugs bzhin mdzad pa yin/ /de ltar byed na smyung gnas med/ /bdag nyid lha ru bskyed pa la/ /mchod na bsod nams brnyas na sdig /gal te smyung gnas byed 'dod na/ /rang nyid tha mal nga rgyal gyis/ /bris sku cho ga bzhin bris la/ /rje dpon bzhin du dngos grub blang*/ /de la sha chang gtor ma med/ /gla rtsi la sogs srog chags dang*/ / 'brel ba'i mchod pa thams cad spongs/ /gu lang mchod pa'i lhag ma dang*/ /gtor ma'i kha zas 'dir mi za/ /lha la phul ba'i dman ma sogs/ /za dang 'gom pa gnyis ka bkag /dkar gsum la sogs kha zas dang*/ /gtsang sbra la sogs brtul zhugs kyis/ /bya ba'i rgyud kyi gsang sngags 'grub/ /spyod dang rnal 'byor rgyud gnyis su/ /las tshogs bsgrub pa 'ga' zhig la/ /gtsang sbra dka' thub bshad pa yod/ /gzhan du dka' thub smyung gnas sogs/ /brtul zhugs khyad par gtsor mi mdzad/ /rang nyid lha yi rnal 'byor bsgom/ /gla rtsi'i ril bu la sogs pa || sraug chags yan lag las byung ba'i/ /mchod pa rnams kyang 'dir mi 'gog /sangs rgyas mchod pa'i lhag ma rnams/ /sdig pa spang phyir bza' 'o zhes/ /rab tu gnas pa'i rgyud las gnang*/ /'byung po'i gtor ma 'dir mi za/ /rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud rnams las/ /a ba dhū tī'i spyod sogs la/ /'byung po'i gtor ma za ba'ang gnang | | dka' thub la sogs brtul zhugs 'gog /'jug pa bde ba'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /gsang sngags rgyal po tshe 'dir 'grub/

/'di dag rgyas par bla ma mchog | mkhas pa'i gsung las shes par gyis/ /grub mtha'i rnam dbye mi shes shing | | rgyud sde'i khyad par ma phyed par/ /cho ga thams cad dkrugs nas ni/ /rang bzo'i rnam thar spyod pa mtshar/ /dbang bzhi yongs su rdzogs pa dang*/ /dang por rang gi khyim du bsgom/ /brtan pa thob nas dur khrod sogs/ /brtan pa chen po thob nas ni/ /lus dang ngag gi brda rnams la/ /legs par sbyangs shing de nyid rtogs | | sa rnams bgrod par bya ba dang*/ /yul rnams dbang du bsdu ba'i phyir | | gnas dang nye ba'i gnas la sogs/ /yul chen sum cu so bdun du/ /rig pa'i brtul zhugs spyod phyir rgyu/ /lugs 'di rnal 'byor chen po yi/ /rgyud dang bstan bcos rnams las gsungs/ /'di 'dra'i spyod pa shes nas ni/ /tshe 'di nyid la rdzogs sangs rgya/ /deng sang gsang sngags mi shes par/ /sngags kyi lugs su 'chos pa mthong*/ /rim pa gnyis po mi bsgom na/ /yul chen sum cu so bdun du//'gro ba sangs rgyas kyis ma gsungs/ /rim pa gnyis po mi bsgom pa'i/ /sgom chen bzang yang pha rol tu/ /phyin pa'i sgom chen las ma 'das/ /mdo las yul chen de dag tu/ /'gro ba'i cho ga bshad pa med/ /gal te gsang sngags mi bsgom zhing | | rtogs pa yod par rlom pa yis/ /yul der phyin na bar chad 'byung*/ /ci yang med pa'i sgom chen gyis/ /phyin yang phan gnod gang yang med/ /u rgyan dzā lan+dha ra dang*/ /gangs can de bī ko ṭa sogs/ /kla klo blun po mu stegs byed/ / 'brog pa rnams kyis gang mod kyang*/ /de dag grub pa thob bam ci/ /gsang sngags bsgom pa'i rtogs pa can/ /brda don 'phrod pa'i skal bar ldan/ /de la yul der gnas pa yi/ /mkha' 'gro rnams kyis byin gyis rlob/ /'di don rnal 'byor chen po yi/ /rgyud sde rnams su legs par ltos/ /des na gsang sngags mi bsgom par | | yul chen bgrod pa don med yin/

/dpal ldan dus kyi 'khor lo dang*/ /mngon pa'i gzhung las gsungs pa yi/ /gangs ri gser gyi bya skyibs dang*/ /'dzam bu'i shing dang sa srung bu/ /glang chen lnga brgyas bskor ba dang*/ /dgra bcom lnga brgya bzhugs pa'i gnas/ /gangs can de ni ti se min// ma dros rgya mtsho ma phang min/ /glang po rnams kyang de na med/ /de bzhin 'dzam bu'i ljon pa dang*/ /gser gyi bya skyibs ga la yod/ /de yi gtan tshigs 'di ltar yin/ /dpal ldan dus kyi 'khor lo las/ /chu bo se tā'i byang phyogs na/ /ri bo gangs can yod par gsungs/ /de yi 'gram na sham+bha la/ /grong khyer bye ba dgu bcu drug /de na rgyal po'i pho brang mchog /ka la pa zhes bya ba yod/ /de na sprul pa'i rgyal po rnams/ /lo grangs brgyad brgyar chos gsung ngo*/ /de na nags tshal sna tshogs dang*/ /bza' shing ra ba du ma yod/ /snyigs ma'i dus su 'phags pa'i yul/ /kla klo'i chos kyis gang bar 'gyur/ /de nas kla klo'i rdzu 'phrul gyis | | sham+bha la ru dmag 'dren 'gyur/ /de tshe phyag na rdo rje yi/ /sprul pa drag po zhes bya ba'i/ /rgyal pos kla klo kun bcom nas/ /'phags pa'i yul gyi bar du yang*/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa spel bar gsungs/ /des na ri bo gangs can du/ /rdzu 'phrul med pas 'gro mi nus/ /mngon pa las kyang 'di skad du/ /'di nas byang du ri nag po/ /dgu 'das gangs ri'o de nas ni/ /spos ngad ldan pa'i tshur rol na/ /chu zheng lnga bcu yod pa'i mtsho/ /zhes sogs mtshan nyid rgyas par gsungs/ /der ni rdzu 'phrul mi ldan pas/ /bgrod par bya ba min zhes bshad/ /da lta'i ti se 'di la ni/ /mtshan nyid 'di dag gang yang med/ /mu stegs byed pa'i gzhung las kyang*/ /shar nub gnyis kyi rgya mtsho'i bar/ /gangs can gyis ni khyab par bshad/ /ha nu man+thas 'phangs pa yi/ /gangs ri'i dum bu tshar ba zhig | ti se yin zhes grog mkhar smra/ /des na dbang phyug chen po'i gnas/

/sa srung bu yis bstan pa'i sa/ /dgra bcom lnga brgya bzhugs pa'i yul/ /da lta'i ti se 'di ma yin/ /rma bya chen mo'i mdo las kyang*/ /gangs can ti se tha dad gsungs | | phal po che yi mdo las kyang*/ /ma dros pa yi chu zheng du/ /dpag tshad lnga bcu lnga bcur gsungs/ /sa gzhir rin chen gseg ma bdal/ /ngos ni rin chen pha gur brtsegs/ /de las 'bab pa'i chu bo bzhi/ /gad+gā glang chen kha nas ni/ /dngul gyi bye ma 'dren cing 'bab/ /si tā seng ge'i kha nas ni/ /rdo rje'i bye ma 'dren cing 'bab/ /sin+dhu glang gi kha nas ni/ /gser gyi bye ma 'dren cing 'bab/ /pak+ṣu rta yi kha nas ni/ /baiḍūr+ya sngon 'dren cing 'bab/ /thams cad kyi ni kha zheng la | | dpag tshad re re yod par gsungs/ /chu bo de bzhis ma dros la/ /lan grangs bdun bdun g.yas bskor nas/ /phyogs bzhi dag tu 'bab par bshad | | de yi bar mtshams thams cad ni/ /ut+pal pad+ma la sogs kyi/ /me tog rnam pa sna tshogs dang*/ /rin chen ljon shing sna tshogs kyis/ /rab tu gang bar gnas pa yin/ /de sogs mtshan nyid rgyas par ni/ /phal po che yi mdo sder ltos | | da lta'i ma phang 'di la ni/ /mtshan nyid de dag gang yang med/ /de la kha cig 'di skad du/ /bya rgod phung po'i ri la yang*/ /dkon brtsegs bzhin du da lta med | | dus kyi stobs kyis yul kun yang*/ /rnam pa 'gyur bar snang zhes zer/ /'di yang phye ste bshad kyi nyon/ /dngos po'i gnas lugs 'chad pa dang*/ /skyon yon bsngags pa rnam gnyis yod/ /skyon dang yon tan sgraugs pa na/ /snyan ngag mkhan gyi lugs bzhin du/ /bya rgod phung po'i ri la yang*/ /mtho ba zlum pa la sogs bshad | | bod kyi thang chen ji bzhin du/ /'phags pa'i yul gyi ri chen yin/ /de ltar 'chad la snyan ngag mkhan/ /skyon du brtsi ba gang yang med/ /dngos po'i gnas lugs 'chad pa na/ /lhag chad 'khrul pa byung ba la/ /de la mkhas rnams skyon du brtsi

| | dper na ba lang bsngags pa'i tshe/ /gangs ri'i phung po 'gro shes pa'am | | sprin chad pa yi dum bu dang*/ /rwa rtse rdo rje 'dra ba dang*/ /rmig pa in+d+ra nī la dang*/ /rnga ma dpag bsam ljon pa sogs/ /gzhan yang skyes bu bsngags pa na | | bzhin la nyi ma zla ba dang*/ /so la gangs ri'i phreng ba sogs/ /rgya che ba la nam mkha'i dpe/ /chung la rdul phran dpe sbyor dang*/ /rags pa'i dpe la ri rab dang*/ /byi ba la ni glang chen dpe/ /phyug po la ni rnam thos bu/ /rgyal phran la yang brgya byin dpe/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen phal pa la'ang*/ /sangs rgyas lta bur bsngags pa ni/ /snyan ngag mkhan la bkag pa med/ /dngos po'i gnas lugs 'chad pa'am/ /mtshan nyid gtan la 'bebs pa na/ /gnas lugs ji bzhin ma yin pa/ /bshad na mkhas rnams ga la dga'/ /des na bya rgod phung po sogs/ /bsngags pa snyan ngag lugs bzhin yin//gangs can ma dros la sogs pa | | dngos po'i gnas lugs 'chad pa na/ /de la 'khrul na kun mkhyen min/ / snyigs ma'i dus kyi shugs brtas pas/ /cung zad ngan par 'gro srid kyi/ /thams cad 'khrul par ga la srid/ /tsa ri tra zhes bya ba'i yul/ /lho phyogs rgya mtsho'i 'gram na yod/ /tsa ri tsa gong de ma yin/ /de bī ko ṭa'i gnas gzhan zhig /tsa ri yin zhes la la smra/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i rgyud las ni/ /de bī ko ṭar bha tra gnas/ /zhes gsungs gzhan yang de nyid las/ /bod yul lhan cig skyais ma ni/ /rdo ba'i phug la brten te gnas/ /yul der gnas pa'i lha mo ni/ /bha tra'i shing la brten zhes gsungs

| | de yi phyogs na bha tra'i shing*/ /yod na yul de 'gal ba med/ /ti se dang ni tsa ri sogs/ /gal te gnas chen yin na yang*/ /yul der 'gro ba'i gang zag ni/ /dbang bskur thob cing dam tshig ldan/ /brda dang brda yi lan shes shing | | rim gnyis rtogs pa brtan pa yis/ /spyod pa'i don du rgyu bar gsungs/ /de lta min pa'i gang zag gis/ /yul der 'gro ba rgyud las bkag kha cig dkar po chig thub las/ /'bras bu sku gsum 'byung zhes zer/ /gcig las 'bras bu 'byung mi nus/ /gal te gcig las 'bras bu zhig /byung yang nyan thos 'gog pa bzhin/ /'bras bu de yang gcig tu 'gyur/ /'ga' zhig chig thub bsgoms pa yi/ /rjes la bsngo ba bya dgos zer/ /'o na chig thub gnyis su 'gyur/ /de la'ang skyabs 'gro sems bskyed dang*/ /yi dam lha bsgom la sogs pa/ /dgos na chig thub du mar 'gyur/ /des na chig thub 'di 'dra'i lugs/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa med/ /thub pas stong nyid bsngags pa ni/ /dngos por 'dzin pa bzlog phyir yin/ /sangs rgyas phyag 'tshal brjod tsam gyis/ /'khor ba las ni thar ces gsungs/ /de bzhin mchod rten bskor ba dang*/ /rten 'brel tsam zhig thos sogs dang*/ /sngags 'bru 'ga' zhig dran tsam gyis/ /sdig pa kun las grol 'gyur zhes/ /gsungs pa'i dgongs pa mi shes par/ /tshigs 'bru tsam la brten mi bya/ /mda' rkyang la ni byed pa med/ /gzhu bzang 'phen pa mkhas gyur na | | de yis 'dod pa'i bya ba 'grub/ /de bzhin stong nyid rkyang pa la/ /byed pa ci yang yod ma yin/ /thabs dang shes rab legs 'brel na/ /'dod pa'i 'bras bu rim bzhin thob/ /rdo rje gur las 'di skad gsungs/ /gal te stong pa thabs yin na | | de tshe sangs rgyas nyid mi 'byung*/ /'bras bu rgyu las gzhan min phyir/ /thabs ni stong pa nyid ma yin/ /lta ba rnams las bzlog pa dang*/ /bdag tu lta ba tshol rnams kyi/

/bdag zhen bsam pa bzlog pa'i phyir/ /stong pa rgyal ba rnams kyis gsungs | | de phyir dkyil 'khor 'khor lo zhes/ /thabs ni bde ba'i sdom pa ste/ /sangs rgyas nga rgyal rnal 'byor gyis/ /sangs rgyas nyid du nges par 'grub//de sogs shin tu gsal bar gsungs/ /rnam snang mngon byang las kyang ni | | thabs dang mi ldan ye shes dang*/ /bslab pa dag kyang gsungs pa ni | | dpa' bo chen pos nyan thos rnams/ /de la gzhug pa'i phyir gsungs so/ / gang dag dus gsum mgon po rnams/ /thabs dang shes rab ldan pa la/ /bslabs nas bla med theg pa ni/ /'dus ma byas pa des thob bo/ /zhes gsungs pa yang shes par gyis/ /chos kyi grags pas rnam 'grel las/ /rnam pa du mar thabs mang po | | yun ring dus su goms pa las/ /de la skyon dang yon tan dag /rab tu gsal ba nyid du 'gyur/ /des na thugs kyang gsal ba'i phyir/ /rgyu yi bag chags spangs pa yin/ /thub chen gzhan don 'jug can gyi/ /bse ru sogs las khyad 'di yin/ /de don phyir na thabs goms pa/ /de nyid ston pa yin par bzhed/ /ces gsungs pa yang de nyid yin/ /des na thabs la ma sbyangs na/ /shes bya thams cad mkhyen pa dang*/ /gzhan don mdzad pa mi srid do/ /thags kyi rgyu rnams phal cher mthun/ /spun gyi dbye bas bzang ngan 'byung*/ /de bzhin stong nyid phal cher mthun/ /'bras bu'i bzang ngan thabs kyis byed/ /stong nyid lta bas mya ngan 'da'/ /thabs la mkhas na rdzogs 'tshang rgya/ /des na sangs rgyas thob 'dod na | | thabs mkhas pa la nan tan gyis/ /dgra bcom pa dang rang sangs rgyas | | rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnam pa gsum/ /rnam par grol bar mtshungs na yang*/ /bzang ngan thabs kyis phye ba yin/ /de yang mdo sde rgyan las ni/ /ji ltar mdud pa'i bye brag gis/ /gos la tshon bkra mi bkra ba/ /de bzhin 'phen pa'i dbang gis ni/ /grol ba'i ye shes bkra mi bkra/ /de skad gsungs pa'ang don 'di yin/

/slob dpon ma ti tsi tras kyang*/ /bse ru'i rwa dang 'dra gang dang*/ /gang yang khyod kyi rjes 'gro slobs/ /zhi ba tsam gyis khyod dang mtshungs/ /bsam yas yon tan tshogs kyis min/ /zhes gsungs pa yang don 'di yin | | des na sangs rgyas thob 'dod na/ /stong pa nyid la 'dris par gyis/ / thabs mkhas pa la 'bad pas sgoms/ /stong nyid la ni 'dris bya yi/ / stong nyid mngon du ma byed ces/ /shes rab pha rol phyin las gsungs/ /stong nyid rkyang pa bsgoms na ni/ /stong nyid nyid kyang rtogs mi nus/ /gal te stong nyid rtogs na yang*/ /nyan thos kyi ni 'gog par ltung*/ /'phags pa dkon mchog brtsegs pa las | | seng ge gang la'ang mi 'jigs mod/ /me chen mthong na 'jigs pa skye | | de bzhin byang chub sems dpa' yang*/ /chos gzhan gang la'ang mi 'jigs kyang || stong pa nyid la skrag ces gsungs/ /de yi dgongs pa 'di ltar yin/ /thabs dang bral ba'i stong nyid kyis/ /mya ngan 'das par 'gyur phyir ro/ /la la stong nyid bsgoms pa las/ /'bras bu sku gsum 'dod pa dang*/ /la la zung 'jug bsgoms pa las/ /'bras bu 'od gsal 'dod pa yod/ /rgyu 'bras phyin ci log pa'i phyir/ / gnyi ga yang ni skyon can yin/ kha cig sa lam mi bgrod par/ /rdzogs 'tshang rgya bar 'dod pa dang*/ /ti se la sogs bskor ba dang*/ /rtsa mdud med sogs 'dod pa yang*/ /rgyud sde'i dgongs pa ma shes pas/ /de dag shin tu 'gal ba yin/ /phyi ru yul rnams bgrod pa dang*/ /nang du rtsa mdud grol ba ni/ /sa bcu la sogs bgrod pa yi/ /rten 'brel nyid kyis 'byung ba yin/ /'di don rnal 'byor chen po yi/ /rgyud kyi sa lam skabs su ltos/ /des na sa lam mi bgrod pa'i/ /yul sogs bgrod pa bzhad gad gnas/ /la la dbang bzhi mi 'dod cing*/ /bskyed rim la sogs lam bzhi po'i/ /rnam par bzhag pa mi 'dod par/ /rdo rje theg pa'i 'bras bu ni/ /sprul sku la sogs sku bzhi zhes/

/'dod pa de yang log shes yin/ kha cig 'bras bu'i mthar thug ni/ /'od gsal yin zhes smra ba thos/ /'di ni 'phags pa'i dgongs pa min/ /rim lnga dang ni spyod bsdus su/ /'od gsal ba las zung 'jug skur/ /ldang ba mthar thug yin par gsungs/ /la la grub thob ngan zhes zer/ /rtogs ldan bzang ba yin no lo/ /grub thob brgyad cu'i nang na yang*/ /rtogs ldan med ces zer ba thos/ /'di 'dra 'phags pa'i gang zag dang*/ /bla ma rnams la skur 'debs y-in/ /'di 'dra 'dzin pa lta ci smos | | thos par gyur kyang rna ba dgab/ /de yi 'thad pa bshad kyis nyon/ /grub thob chung ngu mthong lam yin/ /grub thob 'bring po sa brgyad pa/ /grub thob chen po sangs rgyas sa/ /'phags pa min la grub thob med/ /mdo sde rgyan las 'di skad gsungs | | grub pa dag dang ma grub dang*/ /grub pa dag tu shes par bya/ /ma grub pa yang grub pa dang*/ /grub pa dag tu yang dag 'dod/ /ces gsungs dgongs pa de nyid yin/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug chen po yis/ /lam 'bras las kyang de skad gsungs/ /nged kyi grub thob de 'dra yin/ /rtogs ldan mtshan nyid 'di yin zhes | | mdo rgyud kun las gsungs pa med/ /des na rtogs ldan blun po la | | grags kyi mkhas pa rnams la min/ /la la nyams dang go ba dang*/ /rtogs pa zhes bya rnam pa gsum/ /nyams ni ngan la go ba 'bring*/ /rtogs pa bzang ba yin zhes zer/ /'di yang re zhig brtag par bya/ /nyams zhes bya ba nyams myong la | | zer na sems yod thams cad la/ /myong ba de yang yod pa yin/ /gal te bsgoms pa'i nyams myong la/ /zer na tshogs lam chung ngu nas/ /mthar phyir lam gyi bar du yod/ /'on te so so rang rig pa'i/ /ye shes yin na 'phags pa yi/ /gang zag rnams la nyams de yod/ /go ba dang ni rtogs pa gnyis/ /rnam grangs sgra yin ngo bo gcig /rgya skad gcig la lo tsā ba'i/ /'gyur gyi dbye ba kho nar zad | | rtogs pa gsal dang mi gsal la/

/go dang rtogs par 'dogs na thogs// gzhung lugs 'ga' las bsgoms pa yi/ /ting 'dzin nyams kyi snang ba ste/ / rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi ye shes la/ /dag pa'i snang bar bshad pa yod/ /bsgoms nyams skyon med ces bya ba/ /sangs rgyas sa la bshad pa'ang mthong*/ /de 'dra'i nyams dang rtogs pa la/ /bzang ngan rnam par dbye ba med/ /rtse gcig dang ni spros bral dang*/ /ro gcig dang ni bsgom med bzhi/ /rtse gcig mthong lam spros bral ni | | sa bdun bar yin ro gcig ni/ /dag pa'i sa gsum bsgom med ni/ /sangs rgyas sa zhes la la zer/ /'di yang phye ste bshad kyis nyon/ /so so'i skye bo nyid yin yang*/ /gal te chos mthun tsam brtsi'am/ /'on te 'phags pa nyid yin pa'i | | bden pa'i sa lam dngos su byed/ /so so'i skye bo'i gang zag la/ /chos mthun tsam zhig sgrig na ni/ /chos nas gsungs na 'gal ba med/ /dper na rmi lam nges bstan las/ /thub pa'i mchod rten 'jim pa las/ /byas pa mthong na sa dang po/ /rdo las byas mthong sa gnyis pa/ /rdo thal gyis byugs sa gsum pa | | stegs bu gdugs byas sa bzhi pa/ /rdo skas byi dor byas sa lnga/ /gser gyis sbrel mthong sa drug pa/ /rin chen dra bas g.yogs pa bdun/ /g.yer kha'i dra bas g.yogs pa brgyad/ /sa dgu dang ni bcu pa la/ /rmi lam logs pa mthong med gsung | | de sogs rmi lam bye brag la/ /sa bcu'i dbye ba mdzad pa mthong*/ /'di ni mos pas spyod pa yi/ /sa bcu yin gyi 'phags pa'i min/ /de bzhin rtse gcig la sogs la'ang*/ /gal te mdo dang rgyud sde las/ /mos pa spyod pa'i sa lam du/ / gsungs pa mthong na mi 'gal mod/ /'on kyang 'di 'dra bshad pa med/ /ci ste 'phags pa'i sar byed na/ /mdo rgyud kun dang 'gal bar 'gyur/ kha cig theg pa rang sa na/ /bden pa yin zhes kun la sgrogs/ /'di yang brtag par bya bas nyon | | gal te smras tshad bden na ni/ /brdzun tshig shes bya la mi srid/

/'on te grub mtha' kun bden na/ /'tshe ba chos su smra ba dang*/ /'jig rten pha rol med pa sogs/ /lta log thams cad bden par 'gyur/ /gal te mu stegs mchog rnams la/ /rtag pa'i dngos po la sogs pa/ /brdzun pa'am du ma yod mod kyang | | sbyin dang tshul khrims bzod pa sogs/ /bden pa'ang du ma yod pa'i phyir// bden pa'i cha nas grub mtha' kun/ /rang sa na ni bden snyam na/ /sbyin sogs phal cher bden mod kyang*/ /skyabs gnas dang ni lta ba dang*/ /thabs kyi gnad rnams 'khrul pas na/ /chos gzhan bzang yang skyob mi nus/ /ci ste sangs rgyas theg pa kun/ /rang sa na ni bden snyam na/ /'di yang cung zad brtag par bya/ /sangs rgyas gsung la drang don dang*/ /nges don rnam pa gnyis su yod/ /sgra yang ji bzhin pa dang ni/ /ji bzhin min pa gnyis su gsungs/ /theg pa yang ni 'jig rten dang*/ /'jig rten 'das pa gnyis su gnas/ /bshad pa yang ni dgongs pa dang*/ /ldem por dgongs dang drang po ru/ /dgongs pa zhes bya rnam gsum yod/ /de la 'jig rten mthun 'jug la/ /dgongs nas phyi rol don du gsungs | | tha snyad dpyod pa'i rigs pa la/ /dgongs nas chos rnams sems su gsungs | | dam pa'i don la dgongs nas ni/ /chos kun spros pa bral zhes gsungs | | des na drang ba'i don dang ni/ /ji bzhin min pa'i sgra dag dang*/ / dgongs pa dang ni ldem dgongs dang*/ /'jig rten pa yi theg pa la/ /dgongs te gsungs pa'i mdo rgyud kun/ /de ltar bden par mi bzung ngo*/ /nges pa'i don dang ji bzhin sgra/ /'jig rten 'das pa'i theg pa dang*/ /drang por dgongs pa rnams la ni | | ji skad gsungs bzhin bden par gzung*/ /gal te mu stegs byed la yang*/ / byams dang snying rje sbyin la sogs/ /bden pa'i chos kyang mang po snang*/ /sangs rgyas gsung la'ang drang don dang*/ /dgongs pa dang ni ldem dgongs sogs/ / bden pa min pa'ang gsungs pas na/ /bden brdzun gnyis ka mtshungs pa la

| | sangs rgyas gsung len mu stegs byed/ /spong ba'i rgyu mtshan ci zhe na/ /sangs rgyas drang don gyis khrid nas/ /bden pa nyid la sbyor bar mdzad/ /mu stegs bden pas khrid nas ni/ /brdzun pa nyid la sbyor bar byed/ /des na bdag cag sangs rgyas la/ /gus pa'i rgyu mtshan de ltar yin/ /de bzhin gangs can 'di na yang*/ / rnam thar bzang po bstan nas ni/ /log pa'i chos la sbyor mthong nas/ /mu stegs chos bzhin nged kyis spangs/ /theg pa sna tshogs tshul bstan nas/ /gnad rnams sangs rgyas gsung bzhin du/ /yang dag ston mdzad bla ma de/ /sangs rgyas nyid du bdag gis bzung*/ /chos gzhan legs par ston na yang*/ /chos kyi gnad rnams bcos pa ni/ /shin tu 'jigs pa chen por blta/ /de 'dra ba las skyon byung mang | | 'das pa'i dus na sngon byung ba/ /laṅka mgrin bcu zhes bya bas/ /'bad pas dbang phyug chen po bsgrubs/ /lo grangs sa ya bcu gnyis dang*/ /phyed kyis lhag pa'i dngos grub byin/ khyab 'jug phrag dog gis gzir nas/ /mgrin bcu la ni 'di skad smras/ khyod kyi 'bad pa chen mod kyi/ /dbang phyug gi ni dngos grub chung | | da dung sngar gyi ma yin pa/ /sa ya phrag phyed thub pa slongs/ /mgrin bcus bden par bsams nas ni/ /dbang phyug la ni don de zhus/ /dbang phyug chen pos de byin pas/ /gnad bcos pa yi tshig de yis/ /sngar gyi dngos grub thams cad yal/ /gser can gyi ni dngos grub kyang*/ /de 'dra'i tshul gyis nyams zhes thos | | oṃ med pa yi gsang sngags la/ /g.yon can gyis ni oṃ bcug pas/ / sngags kyi nus pa nyams pa mthong*/ /de bzhin swāhā hūm̐ phaṭa sogs/ /yod pa rnams la phri ba dang*/ /med pa rnams la bsnan pa dang*/ /gzhan yang sngags kyi gnad rnams la/ /g.yon can rnams kyis bcos pa yis/ /gsang sngags dag gi nus pa rnams | | nyams shing 'gyangs pa mang po mthong*/ /de bzhin chos kyi gnad rnams kyang

| | cung zad cung zad bcos pa las/ /dngos grub nyams par 'gyur bar gsungs | | de phyir chos gzhan legs na yang*/ /gnad rnams bcos na thams cad 'jig /des na nyan thos theg pa la/ /sdom pa dang ni bden bzhi'i gnad/ / bcos na nyan thos chos kun 'jig /theg pa che la sems bskyed dang*/ /de yi bslab bya'i gnad bcos na/ /theg pa chen po'i chos kun 'jig /gsang sngags la ni dbang bskur dang*/ /rim pa gnyis kyi gnad bcos na/ /gsang sngags kyi ni chos kun 'jig /des na da lta'i chos 'ga' la/ /gnad kyi gnas rnams bcos pa ru | | dogs pa'i chos lugs 'ga' zhig yod/ /de yang mdo tsam bshad kyis nyon | | so sor thar pa'i sdom pa ni/ /byang chub bar du blangs gyur na/ /so sor thar pa ci nas 'jig /'di yang gnad rnams bcos par dogs/ /byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa la/ /dbu ma'i lugs bzhin mi byed par/ /sems tsam pa yi cho ga ni | | skye bo kun la byed pa mthong*/ /'di yi cho ga nges par 'jig /'di yang gnad rnams bcos par mthong*/ /sems bskyed kyi ni bslab bya'i mchog /bdag gzhan brje ba'i byang chub sems/ /bsgom du mi rung zhes smra ba/ /'di yang gnad rnams bcos par mthong*/ /gsang sngags kyi ni dbang bskur ba/ /med kyang gsang sngags bsgom rung zer/ /rdo rje 'chang gis bkag pas na/ /'di yang gnad rnams bcos par dogs/

/gsang sngags lam gyi mchog gyur pa/ /rim gnyis tshul bzhin mi bsgom par/ /rang bzo'i gdams ngag du ma yis/ /blun po nges shes skyed pa thos/ /mdo rgyud kun las 'di bkag pas/ /'di yang gnad rnams bcos par dogs/ /bskyed pa'i rim pa'i mthar thug pa/ /dbu rgyan la ni rigs bdag 'byung*/ /rigs bdag de ni bla ma yin/ /'di ni gal te 'chol gyur na | | dngos grub med par rgyud las gsungs/ /'on kyang bla ma spyi bo ru/ /bsgom bya min zhes la la zer/ /'di yang gnad rnams bcos par dogs/ /yod pa'i dge ba zhes bya ba/ /chos kyi dbyings la bsams nas ni/ /de ni bsngo ba'i rgyur byed pa/ /dmigs pa med pa'i chos kyi dbyings/ /dmigs pa'i dge bar bsgyur ba 'di/ /bsngo ba dug dang bcas par gsungs/ /'di yang gnad rnams bcos par dogs/ /de bzhin gtum mo bsgom pa dang*/ /phyag rgya chen po la sogs dang*//dam tshig dang ni sdom pa yi/ /gnad rnams bcos pa mang mod kyi/ /gsang sngags yin phyir 'dir mi bshad/ /chos rnams kun gyi rtsa ba ni/ /stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can/ /thabs dang shes rab zung 'jug tu/ /mdo rgyud kun las rgyal bas gsungs | | la la spros bral rkyang pa ni/ /dkar po chig thub yin zhes zer/ /'di yang gnad rnams bcos par dogs/ /gnad rnams min pa'i chos gzhan 'ga'/ /ma tshang ba dang lhag pa dang*/ /cung zad 'khrul par gyur na yang*/ /nyes pa chen po bskyed mi nus/ /chos kyi gnad rnams bcos gyur na/ /chos gzhan bzang yang 'tshang mi rgya/ /dper na 'gro ba'i srog rtsa dang*/ /ljon shing rnams kyi rtsa ba dang*/ / sa bon gyi ni skye sa dang*/ /thags rnams kyi ni srog shing dang*/ /bcud kyis len gyi rtsa ba dang*/ /dbang po rnams kyi gnad rnams ni/ /'chugs na bsgrub tu mi rung bzhin | | de bzhin chos kyi gnad 'chugs na/ /legs legs 'dra yang 'bras bu med | | des na la la 'khrul yang bla/

/gnad rnams 'khrul med dpyad dgos so/ /de la gnad rnams 'chos pa'i bdud/ /la la sangs rgyas dngos su ston/ kha cig mkhan po slob dpon dang*/ /bla ma'i cha lugs 'dzin pa dang*/ /pha ma'am nye du'i cha lugs kyis/ /sems can rnams la bslu bar byed/ /'ga' zhig rtsub mor smra byed cing*/ /bsdigs pa'i tshul gyis bsgyur bar byed/ /la la 'jam por smra byed cing | | byams pa'i tshul gyis slu bar byed/ /la la sangs rgyas gsungs pa'i lung | | phyin ci log tu bshad nas sgyur/ /la la rigs pa bzang po la/ /ngan pa yin zhes bshad nas bsgyur/ /la la rigs pa ngan pa la/ /bzang po lta bur bcos nas bsgyur/ /la la zas nor ci 'dod pa'i/ /rngan pa byin nas chos log ston | | la la lus dang sems la ni/ /ting 'dzin cung zad bskyed nas kyang*/ /de la yid ches skyes pa dang*/ /log pa'i chos rnams bstan nas slu/ /la la mngon par shes pa dang*/ /rdzu 'phrul cung zad bstan nas kyang*/ /blun po yid ches bskyed nas ni | | phyi nas chos log ston par byed/ /la la nga yis 'di ltar bsgoms/ /de la rtogs pa 'di skyes pas/ khyed kyang 'di ltar gyis shig ces/ / rang gi nyams myong yin pa yi/ /tshul du byas nas log par 'chos/ /mdor na sangs rgyas gsung rab dang*/ /phal cher mthun par ston byed cing*/ /gnad rnams log par ston pa'i chos | | legs legs 'dra bar ston na yang*/ /bdud kyi byin rlabs yin no zhes | | mdo rgyud kun las gsal bar gsungs/ /'di dag ji ltar byung ba'i tshul | | mdo tsam nga yis bshad kyis nyon/ /rin chen bzang po bzhugs pa'i tshe | | sangs rgyas skar rgyal zhes bya ba/ /dpral ba nas ni 'od 'byin cing*/ /bar snang la ni skyil krung 'cha'/ /res 'ga' 'jag ma'i khri la sdod/ /stong pa nyid kyi chos rnams ston/ /byams dang snying rje che bar snang*/ /de yi chos kyis gzhan dag la | | ting nge 'dzin yang skye bar byed/

/de la 'jig rten thams cad mos/ /shākya'i rgyal po'i bstan pa dang*/ /'dra min cung zad bcos par 'chad/ /de yi bstan pa shin tu 'phel/ /de tshe rin chen bzang po yis/ /sgrub pa zla ba drug mdzad nas | | ting 'dzin brtan pas de drung byon/ /sangs rgyas skar rgyal bar snang la | | skyil krung bcas nas chos 'chad tshe/ /rin chen bzang pos gzigs tsam gyis | | sa la lhung nas brgyal zhes grag /gal te rin bzang zhes bya ba'i/ /skyes mchog de tshe mi bzhugs na/ /sangs rgyas skar rgyal zhes bya ba'i/ /chos log bstan pa 'byung zhes gsungs/ /nag po'i phyogs la dga' ba yi/ /skar rgyal zhes bya'i klu chen zhig /skyes ngan zhig la zhugs nas ni/ /sangs rgyas gzugs su brdzus zhes gsungs/ /'di 'dra'i rigs kyi bdud rigs 'ga'/ /mi'am 'phags pa'i gzugs bzung nas/ / log pa'i bstan pa spel ba'i phyir/ /chos dang bsres nas gnad rnams su/ / log chos bsres nas 'chad pa srid/ /dper na kha zas bzang po la/ /sbyar ba'i dug gis phal cher gsod/ /dug rkyang yin par shes na ni/ / 'ga' yang gsad par nus ma yin/ /de bzhin chos bzang 'ga' zhig la/ /chos log bslad pas pha rol slu/ /chos log rkyang par go na ni/ /'ga' yang bdud kyis slu mi nus/ /ri dwags rnga ma ma bstan na/ /bong sha btsong bar mi nus ltar/ /de bzhin bzang spyod ma bstan na/ /log pa'i chos kyis slu mi nus/ /bdud kyi byin rlabs thams cad kyang*/ /ngan pa kho nar nges pa min/ /'on kyang bzang po'i nang nas ni/ /gnad rnams cung zad bcos pa yis/ /phan pa lta bus pha rol slu | | 'di 'dra shes par byas nas ni/ /chos kyi gnad rnams mdo rgyud bzhin/ / ma bslad par ni legs par zung*/ /shing rta'i srog shing chag gyur na/ /'khor lo bzang yang 'gro mi nus/ /srog gi dbang po 'gags gyur na/ /dbang po gzhan dag bya byed med/ /de bzhin chos kyi gnad 'chugs na/ /chos gzhan bzang yang nus med 'gyur/

/rdzogs sangs rgyas las mkhas pa yi/ /gang zag 'jig rten gsum na med/ /des na de yis gsungs pa yi/ /mdo rgyud rnam par dkrug mi bya/ /mdo rgyud dkrugs na chos spong zhing*/ /'phags pa rnams kyang smad 'gyur zhes/ /mgon po byams pas rgyud blar gsungs/ /'khrul pa'i grub mtha' sun 'byin pa'i/ /rnam gzhag cung zad bshad kyis nyon/ /mu stegs ston pa dbang phyug sogs/ /mnan pa'i sangs rgyas mthong nas ni/ /de bzlog pa yi bris sku zhig /mu stegs dbyangs can dga' bas byas/ /'khas pa chen po dzñā na shrīs | | de dang rtsod pa'i rtsod grwa ru/ /rang gzhan gnyis ka'i sde pa dang*/ /rgyal po sogs kyi dpang po'i grwar/ /sangs rgyas mnan pa rang bzo yin/ /des na 'khrul pa yin par bsgrags/ /des kyang dbang phyug mnan pa yi/ /sangs rgyas rang bzo yin zhes bsgres/ /de la mkhas pas 'di skad brtsad/ /sangs rgyas chos rje sa paṇa gsung rab dpe bsdur ma pod gnyis pa/ mes po'i shul bzhag las/ sa skya bka' 'bum/ PAGE 76PAGE 77 chos rje sa paṇa gsung rab dpe bsdur ma pod gnyis pa/ mes po'i shul bzhag las/ sa skya bka' 'bum/ PAGE 60PAGE 59
